title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

 This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Sweden.
   

  

**About Product Management**
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
   

  

 Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes
 **Grafana Federal Cloud** 
 , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes
 **Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC)** 
 , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.
   

  

 Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.
   

  

 Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.
   

  

 As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:
   

  

* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
* Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
* Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
* Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
* Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments


 We’re excited about you because you have
   

  

* 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
* Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
* Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
* Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
* Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization


 Bonus Points
   

  

* Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
* Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
* Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
* Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
* Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
* Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies


**In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 996,819 - SEK 1,196,182. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.**
* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Management Consultant - AI Strategy & Transformation
description:
De flesta organisationer har redan startat sina AI-piloter. Frågan är inte längre om de ska investera, utan var, och hur de ser till att värdet faktiskt realiseras. Det är där vi arbetar.
   

  

**Om Influence**
 Influence är ett managementkonsultbolag som kombinerar strategi med förmågan att genomföra den. Vi mäter kvaliteten på en strategi i vad som händer sedan. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder, med genuin omtanke och modet att säga det som behöver sägas, så att varje uppdrag lämnar efter sig en skarpare organisation och inte ett beroende av oss.
   

  

 Vi är en del av Newground, en allians av specialistbolag under ett gemensamt tak. Det ger oss djup inom AI, data och teknik när vi behöver det, och kollektiv intelligens som grund för allt vi gör.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Vi är varken ett utbildningsteam för AI eller en systemintegratör. Vi hjälper ledningsgrupper att fatta bättre beslut: var de ska satsa, vad de ska låta bli, hur de går från experiment till skala och hur strategi, organisation och arbetssätt måste förändras för att värdet ska bli verkligt.
   

  

 Du arbetar direkt med kundernas seniora beslutsfattare. Du prioriterar möjligheter, bedömer om organisationen faktiskt kan realisera dem, formar transformationsroadmaps, designar operating models och styrning, och leder kunder från enskilda initiativ till effekt i hela verksamheten.
   

  

 Du är bryggan mellan affärsledning och tekniska specialister. Du förstår AI och teknik tillräckligt väl för att ifrågasätta antaganden, leverantörslöften och orealistiska use cases, men din styrka ligger i affärsmässigt omdöme och förändring. Du är rösten i rummet som utmanar önsketänkande, och du gör det på ett sätt som bygger förtroende.
   

  

 Du bygger också affär. Att utveckla kundrelationer, forma nya uppdrag och driva vårt erbjudande inom Tech-Driven Reinvention framåt är en central del av rollen.
   

  

**Vem du är**
* 5–10 års erfarenhet från management consulting eller en strategisk transformationsroll
* Du förstår AI, data och teknik ur ett affärsperspektiv och är trygg i att utmana tekniska antaganden utan att själv äga leveransen
* Du har drivit verklig förändring, inte bara strategi på papper: nya operating models, arbetssätt, governance eller förmågebyggande
* Du är van vid komplexa organisationer och har trovärdighet hos ledningsgrupper
* Du kan skilja det som är strategiskt attraktivt från det en organisation faktiskt kan genomföra
* Du balanserar tydlig riktning uppifrån med experimenterande och ägarskap nära verksamheten
* Du skapar samsyn mellan affär och teknik, och du har kommersiellt driv
* Du är flytande i svenska och engelska


 Erfarenhet av AI- eller data governance, portföljstyrning, digital- eller mjukvarustrategi eller storskalig transformation är meriterande.
   

  

**Varför Influence**
 Du får vara med och bygga vårt erbjudande inom Tech-Driven Reinvention, inte bara leverera det. Du arbetar med några av de mest avgörande frågorna ledningsgrupper står inför just nu, med stora och medelstora bolag inom retail, industri och tjänstesektorn, och med Newgrounds specialister vid din sida.
   

  

 Och du gör det i en kultur som folk stannar för. Vi lever efter det vi säger: great minds, genuine hearts, sustainable results.
   

  

 Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Välkommen med din.
   

  

 Influence. For a wiser tomorrow.
   

  

 Influence är ett managementkonsultföretag – som leder vägen till "a wiser tomorrow". Genom forskning i Kollektiv intelligens och kunskapsintegration, skapar vi hållbara resultat.

title: Experience Transformation Senior Manager to our team in Stockholm
description:
**Lead a team. Shape the future of CRM. Make a real impact.**
 Are you an experienced consulting leader with strong business understanding, expertise in
 **Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365** 
 , and a passion for transforming how businesses sell, serve and engage customers?
   

  

 Join
 **Accenture Song** 
 to lead and grow our established Sales & Service consulting team in Sweden, advise leading organizations, win new business, deliver successful CRM transformations and shape our customer transformation practice.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 In this role, you will:
   

  

  

- Lead and grow the team: coach and develop consultants, capabilities, expertise and career paths; support recruitment; and build a collaborative culture of consulting excellence, knowledge sharing and strong client outcomes.

- Advise clients and deliver transformations: advise senior business and technology stakeholders; shape CRM strategies, roadmaps, business cases and operating models; and lead multidisciplinary engagements from strategy and design through technology, implementation and organizational change to measurable value.

- Grow the business: build relationships with existing and prospective Swedish clients, identify opportunities, shape proposals, win and expand engagements, and position Accenture Song as a trusted Sales & Service transformation partner.

- Shape the practice: collaborate with Nordic leadership and technology partners to develop propositions, expand our market presence and Sales & Service practice in Sweden, and help clients use CRM, AI, automation and data to improve sales effectiveness, customer service and operational performance.

**Who We're Looking For**
 You're an experienced consulting professional with strong client advisory skills, commercial judgment, an entrepreneurial and collaborative mindset, and a genuine interest in developing people. You understand how organizations operate, how CRM enables business transformation and how to deliver lasting improvements.
   

  

 Ideally, you bring:
   

  

  

- Consulting and transformation: typically 10+ years in management consulting, business transformation or technology-enabled advisory, with a successful record of leading CRM or Sales & Service transformations from strategy and business-case development through implementation and adoption.

- CRM expertise: solid experience with Salesforce and/or Microsoft Dynamics 365 and how they enable sales, customer service and commercial transformation. Deep expertise in either is highly relevant; experience with both is an advantage.

- Leadership and commercial skills: experience building, coaching and developing consultants or multidisciplinary teams; developing senior client relationships; identifying opportunities; and creating proposals.

- Senior stakeholder impact: the ability to challenge thinking, translate complex business issues into clear recommendations and actionable plans, and develop both the practice and people around you.

 Swedish or Nordic enterprise-client experience and familiarity with AI, Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot, CPQ or Field Service are strong advantages. Fluent English is required; Swedish is a strong advantage.
   

  

 You need not be a technical architect or expert in every platform; what matters is connecting business needs with CRM capabilities, leading successful transformations and inspiring delivery teams.
   

  

**Why join Accenture Song?**
 Lead an established team and help define its direction, capabilities and growth. The role combines people development, meaningful client engagements and direct responsibility for business growth—not sales or delivery alone. You'll help ambitious Swedish organizations transform Sales & Service using Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365, data and emerging AI; draw on Accenture's strategy, technology, industry and design expertise; and collaborate with Nordic teams and global technology partners. In a culture that values initiative, collaboration and leadership, you'll influence our ways of working, market offerings and people development, with competitive Swedish benefits, continuous professional development and career growth across Accenture.
   

  

**About Accenture Song**
 Accenture Song accelerates growth by reinventing how organizations connect with, sell to and serve customers, combining business strategy, creativity, data, AI and technology with local insight and Accenture's global capabilities to solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful customer and commercial outcomes.
   

  

**Interested?**
 Ready to combine consulting expertise, CRM experience and people leadership? Apply through our career portal; applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.
   

  

 For questions about the application or recruitment process, please contact
 **therese.bals@accenture.com** 
 .

title: Testare/Testledare

 CGI växer och vi söker fler erfarna kollegor som vill vara med och utveckla våra uppdrag, kundrelationer och affär inom offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Hos oss får du arbeta med samhällsviktiga verksamheter där digitalisering, förändring och ny teknik skapar nya möjligheter. Vi söker dig som är affärsorienterad, trygg i konsultrollen och vill bidra både i kunduppdrag och till CGI:s fortsatta utveckling.
   

  

 Du har förmåga att se kundens behov, skapa förtroende och bidra till hur vi utvecklar våra erbjudanden, vår affärsmodell och vårt långsiktiga värde på marknaden. AI är en naturlig del av utvecklingen – och vi ser gärna att du har förståelse för hur tekniken kan användas klokt och ansvarsfullt i offentlig verksamhet.
   

  

 Vill du bidra till kvalitet i lösningar som används i samhällsviktiga verksamheter?
   

  

 Som testare eller testledare hos CGI arbetar du nära verksamhet, utveckling och kund. Du är van att ta ansvar för kvalitet, skapa struktur i testarbetet och bidra till trygga leveranser i komplexa miljöer.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Vill du bidra till kvalitet i lösningar som används i samhällsviktiga verksamheter?
   

  

 Som testare eller testledare hos CGI arbetar du nära verksamhet, utveckling och kund. Du är van att ta ansvar för kvalitet, skapa struktur i testarbetet och bidra till trygga leveranser i komplexa miljöer.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi söker dig som är noggrann, strukturerad och trygg i dialog med både kund och team. Du har ett konsultmässigt arbetssätt, förstår kvalitetens betydelse för affären och vill utvecklas vidare inom offentlig sektor.
   

  

 Språk, medborgarskap och säkerhet
   

  

 Svenska är ett krav då våra kunduppdrag huvudsakligen genomförs på svenska. Du behöver kunna uttrycka dig obehindrat i både tal och skrift.

 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: SAP Test Lead
description:
**Role:** 
 SAP Test Lead
   

  

**Job Ref Id:** 
 JD-1277
   

  

**Competence level:** 
 Senior
   

  

**Start date:** 
 2026-11-02
   

  

**End date:** 
 2027-03-31
   

  

**Extension option:** 
 Yes
   

  

**Scope:** 
 100%
   

  

**Location:** 
 Solna
   

  

**Language:** 
 English, Swedish
   

  

**Application deadline:** 
 2026-10-31
   

  

**Number of consultants:** 
 1
   

  

**Security clearance:** 
 No
   

  

**About The Assignment**
 We are looking for an experienced Test Lead to join our program test team supporting a large ERP (SAP S/4HANA) transformation in the paper and pulp industry. The Test Lead will drive test planning and execution across test phases, lead teams of testers, manage incidents and defects, and provide communication and training related to testing. The role is part of the Test Center of Excellence and reports to the central Test Manager.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Develop a comprehensive test plan with the Test CoE team, including scope, requirements and testing methods.
* Lead teams of testers and monitor test progress, ensuring team members are trained and productive.
* Oversee execution of test cases and coordinate with BPL/SME, solution architects, developers and other stakeholders to prioritize and schedule testing activities.
* Lead and drive test execution in different test phases, initially covering user acceptance testing.
* Oversee defect management: document, track and follow up on issues to ensure timely resolution with the implementation partner and development team.
* Ensure effective communication and regular reporting of testing progress, risks and issues to project stakeholders.
* Provide leadership support and advocacy for test methodology and test data coordination within the Test CoE.


**Requirements**
**Mandatory**
* Documented Test management e.g. ISTQB certification or similar education and communication skills
* Bachelor or Master degree in applicable area is preferred
* Proven experience as a leader in managing test in a large complex transformation program
* Strong understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and different testing methodologies. Advantage of experience in testing in an agile methodology.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end test data quality management.
* Extensive experience and understanding of large global ERP standard system processes and it is an advantage if you have experience with SAP.
* System implementation experience is required, experience in process industry is preferred.
* Excellent documentation skills to maintain clear and concise records of testing activities. This includes writing test plans, test cases, and test reports.
* Strong test management abilities, including the ability to prioritize tasks, manage timelines, and meet deadlines.
* Experience in larger Test management tool.
* Fluency in English and Swedish in both verbal and written.
* Strong leadership and team management skills and excellent communication and interpersonal skills, capable of working effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to establish and maintain strong relationships.
* Excellent analytical skills and you should have a keen eye for detail and be able to think critically to evaluate the quality.
* Excellent problem-solving skills is vital. Be able to think outside the box and come up with innovative solutions to overcome testing challenges.
* Hands-on problem-solving abilities and a strategic mindset.


**Nice-to-have**
* Bachelor or Master degree in applicable area is preferred
* Experience in testing in an agile methodology.
* Experience in process industry is preferred.

title: Information Security Intern
description:
Digital & IT
   

  

* Stockholm


 Information Security Intern
   

  

 Do you want to contribute to create positive environmental impact on the society? If so, you can be our next talented intern.
   

  

*Research shows that women and other under-represented groups within our industry hesitate to apply unless they tick most boxes of a role description. At Stegra, we are building an impact company with sustainability at its core. We need a diverse, inclusive, and authentic team to rally behind our purpose of de-carbonizing hard-to-abate industries, starting with steel.
   

  

 So, if you are equally passionate about our purpose yet concerned that your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications stated in the job advert, we strongly encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate, either for this role – or for another upcoming role in our rapidly growing business.*
**About Us**
 Stegra is on a mission to disrupt the global steel industry by producing green steel, with the end goal of bringing down CO2 emissions to zero. By using green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity instead of coal; water and heat will be our primary emissions. By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitalized, and sustainable plant in Boden, located in northern Sweden - currently in construction phase. But this is just the beginning – our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize other industries in addition to steel, and we look forward to what’s next in store for us.
   

  

**Information Security Intern**
 Are you curious about cybersecurity, secure applications, and the rapidly evolving world of AI? We’re looking for a motivated student who wants to learn, experiment, and build hands-on experience in information security at Stegra.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 As soon as possible
   

  

**Duration:** 
 6–12 months, part-time (50%)
   

  

**Location:** 
 our office in Stockholm
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 As part of the internship, you’ll have the opportunity to:
   

  

* Help develop and improve our application security and secure development practices.
* Collaborate with teams across our Digital department to embed security into the way we work.
* Turn security requirements into practical improvements for our applications.
* Get hands-on with AI security, including securing AI/ML pipelines, models, and applications.
* Take part in application risk assessments and help identify ways to reduce security risks.
* Contribute to the development of an internal security and compliance tool.
* Help create and test disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Review existing processes, explore what could work better, and contribute your own ideas for improvement.


 You won’t be expected to know all of this from day one - the internship is about learning, contributing, and building practical experience along the way.
   

  

**Your background**
* You are currently studying or have recently completed a degree in Information Security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field, and have some programming experience.
* Previous internships, student projects, hackathons, courses, or extracurricular activities related to cybersecurity are a plus, but not a requirement.


**What We’d Love To See**
* An interest in application security, secure development, and cybersecurity.
* Some familiarity with security concepts such as threat modeling.
* Curiosity about AI and emerging security challenges.
* An analytical mindset and attention to detail.


**Who You Are**
 You’re
 **curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving problems** 
 . You enjoy learning and contributing your ideas, and you’re comfortable taking ownership of your work while asking for support when you need it.
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
* Hands-on experience with application security, secure development, and emerging AI security topics.
* The opportunity to work on real-world cybersecurity challenges, not just theoretical exercises.
* Guidance from experienced professionals who will support your learning and development.
* Experience collaborating with different teams and seeing how security works across a growing organization.
* The chance to contribute your ideas and make a real impact on how we protect our applications, systems, and people.
* Practical experience and new skills that will help you take the next step in your cybersecurity career.


 If you are passionate about making actual change and having a positive impact on society and our planet, Stegra offers a unique opportunity to be part of a fun and professional team with high ambitions.
   

  

 You will get the opportunity to shape your future career together with a company focusing on creating a culture where everyone can thrive and feel a sense of belonging. In the end, we know that Stegra’s growth and success is dependent on our people and we can’t wait to shape the future of steelmaking and other industries together as a team.

Construction of our first project – an integrated plant producing green hydrogen, green iron and green steel – is well underway in Boden, Sweden. title: Supportspecialist till Agronod
description:
**Vill du hjälpa svenska lantbrukare att få mindre administration och mer tid till det som verkligen spelar roll?** 




*Hos Agronod blir du den som hjälper användare att lyckas med våra tjänster samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla framtidens digitala lösningar för svenskt lantbruk.*




**Om Rollen** 




 Svenska lantbrukare använder många olika system och behöver ofta lämna samma uppgifter på många olika ställen. Det skapar dubbelarbete och tar tid från det som verkligen är viktigt: att producera mat. Därför finns Agronod, den neutrala plattformen för svensk lantbruksdata. Här kan lantbrukare återanvända sin data och själva bestämma vem som får använda den.
   

  





 När data kan återanvändas skapas nya möjligheter. I Agrosfär kan lantbrukare använda data som redan finns i gårdens system för att göra sin klimatberäkning. Nu utvecklar vi också en lösning för att minska den tidskrävande administrationen vid kontroller. Agronod-plattformen öppnade 2024 och i dag är omkring en tredjedel av Sveriges heltidslantbrukare anslutna. I takt med att fler använder Agronod och Agrosfär växer behovet av bra support. Därför söker vi nu en
 **supportspecialist** 
 som vill hjälpa våra användare och samtidigt bidra till att plattformen och våra produkter blir enklare att använda.
   

  





**I rollen kommer du att** 



* ansvara för och utveckla Agronods support
* hjälpa lantbrukare över hela Sverige via telefon och mejl
* fånga upp återkommande frågor och problem och omsätta dem i förbättringsförslag
* ta fram och utveckla guider, hjälpartiklar och annat stöd för våra användare
* fånga upp användarnas behov och bidra till hur framtidens produkter och tjänster utvecklas, du blir en viktig länk mellan våra användare och produktteamen som utvecklar Agronod och Agrosfär.



**Vi söker dig som** 




 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet från lantbruket och drivs av att hjälpa människor. Du gillar att lösa problem, är nyfiken på hur saker fungerar och tar gärna ansvar tills frågan är löst. Du är bra på att lyssna, förklara och göra det som känns krångligt enkelt att förstå.
   

  





**Vi tror också att du:** 



* arbetar strukturerat och kan hålla ihop flera ärenden samtidigt
* är nyfiken och tycker om att förstå varför problem uppstår
* tar initiativ och driver frågor vidare när det behövs
* trivs med att samarbeta och hitta lösningar tillsammans med andra



**Det är ett plus om du:** 



* har arbetat med support eller kundservice
* är nyfiken på ny teknik







**Om Agronod** 




 Du blir en del av ett engagerat team på
 **15** 
 personer där lantbrukskompetens möter teknik, hållbarhet, produktutveckling och affärsutveckling. Här får du stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt och lösningar. Vårt gemensamma uppdrag är att göra det enkelt och säkert att dela och återanvända lantbruksdata – för mindre administration och större nytta i svenskt lantbruk. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor i Gröna näringslivets hus i Stadshagen, Stockholm. De flesta av oss är på kontoret tre till fyra dagar i veckan
 *.* 
***Lär känna oss på Agronod.com/omoss***




**Så söker du** 




 Vi gör urval löpande, så skicka gärna din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Skicka ditt cv eller en länk till din LinkedIn-profil och några rader om varför du är intresserad av rollen och av Agronod.
   

  





 Har du frågor om tjänsten? Kontakta Anna Silvander, anna.silvander@agronod.com
   

  





 Sökord:
 **Supportspecialist lantbruk, Kundsupportspecialist, Användarstöd och supportspecialist, Supportspecialist till Agronod, Supportspecialist inom lantbruksdata, Customer Success Specialist**




*Vi har valt hur vi genomför den här rekryteringen och undanber oss därför kontakt från rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag samt annonssäljare.*

title: Microsoft Sales Executive
description:
Devoteam is a Microsoft Partner in the Nordics, helping customers get more value from Microsoft Cloud.
   

  

 We combine strong Microsoft capabilities with expertise across cloud, platform engineering, security, data and managed services.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Microsoft Sales Executive who already knows the ecosystem and can help us grow the business across the Nordics.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are looking for someone who already knows how the Microsoft game works. You know the Microsoft field. You understand the partner model, CSP, co-sell and how opportunities are created together with Microsoft.
   

  

**This is a hunter role.**
 Your job is to open new accounts, create pipeline and close business. You will own a defined set of named accounts across the Nordics, with clear territory and account ownership.
   

  

 You will work closely with Microsoft and with our own experts across Cloud, Platform Engineering, Security and Managed Services to build opportunities that go beyond licensing.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build new business across a defined portfolio of Nordic accounts.
* Develop relationships with Microsoft sellers, specialists and partner teams.
* Create joint pipelines through account mapping, co-sell and direct customer engagement.
* Own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed deal.
* Build and structure CSP opportunities where relevant.
* Turn Microsoft relationships into larger consulting, cloud, security and managed services engagements.
* Work closely with our technical teams to shape solutions around real customer needs.
* Build long-term relationships with customers and expand existing accounts.
* Keep a strong view of your territory, pipeline and next opportunities.


**Territory**
 You will work with named accounts across clearly defined and protected territories in the Nordic region.
   

  

**Our main focus is enterprise customers within:**
* Manufacturing
* Retail
* Financial Services


 There will also be opportunities in other sectors where we see a strong fit.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 We are not looking for someone who wants to learn Microsoft sales from scratch. We are looking for someone who has already done it.
   

  

**What Matters To Us**
* You know Microsoft in the Nordics
* You already have relationships in the Microsoft ecosystem and understand how to work with the field to create business.
* You have a proven track record of opening new accounts, creating opportunities and closing complex technology deals.
* You understand CSP and cloud commercial models
* You know how Microsoft cloud deals are structured and how to build commercial opportunities around them.
* You can sell beyond licensing
* You understand how to connect Microsoft technology with consulting, migration, platform engineering, security and managed services.
* You can work with technical people
* You do not need to be an engineer, but you can understand customer challenges and work with experts to turn them into a strong proposition.
* You can sell to senior stakeholders You are comfortable working with CIOs, CTOs, IT leaders and business decision-makers.
* You take ownership
* You know your accounts, your pipeline and what needs to happen next.
* You speak fluent English
* A Nordic language is a strong advantage.


**The profile we are looking for
   

  

 A simple way to describe it:** 
 If we put you in a room with the Microsoft organisation in Sweden or the Nordics tomorrow, you should already know the people in the room.
   

  

 And they should know you.
   

  

**Additional Information**
**What you get**
* Clear account ownership and protected territories.
* Direct access to strong Microsoft technical expertise.
* The ability to sell across several capabilities, not just one service.
* A Nordic role with room to build.
* Hybrid and flexible working.
* Access to training and certifications through Devoteam Academy.
* Opportunities across Devoteam’s international network.


**If you know the Microsoft ecosystem, know how to create business with it and like building from scratch, we want to talk.**

title: Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialist, Nordics
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of quota-carrying enterprise sales experience.
* Experience building business cases through workshops or product demos to business executives.
* Experience developing partnerships with technical stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Data Scientists).
* Ability to communicate in English and Swedish fluently to manage client relationships in the region.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience positioning modern cloud data platforms, lakehouses, real-time streaming, or GenAI platforms against legacy or other proprietary enterprise systems.
* Experience working with Global System Integrators, hyperscalers, or ISVs to co-sell and accelerate pipeline.
* Experience closing large-scale data and AI transformation deals within specific regulated or high-growth enterprise verticals (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare/Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing)
* Practical understanding of how modern cloud architectures, data governance (e.g., cataloging, lineage, compliance), and clean data estates enable AI and real-time analytics.


**About The Job**
 As the Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialists team, we work together with Field Sales Representatives (Account Managers), Customer Engineers, and our Partners to help our customers modernize their operational and analytical data foundations on GCP. We enable them to transition to modern, unified cloud architectures that position data as the absolute foundation for AI success and power next-generation AI and intelligent applications.
   

  

 As a master of complex lakehouse solutions, data governance, and AI, you are the exact sales expert we need to translate technical capabilities into high-impact business outcomes.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

 Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
   

  

 Sweden: kr1080000 - kr1100000 (SEK) + 100% bonus target + equity + benefits
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Learn more about benefits at Google .
   

  

* Deliver against quota and achieve or exceed strategic business and growth goals. Drive net-new greenfield logos and workloads in existing accounts through proactive campaigns.
* Run complex, multi-threaded business cycles from initial discovery and value hypothesis to ROI business case creation and commercial close.
* Engage business leaders, Chief Data Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Marketing Officer, Chief AI Officer, through value-selling, tying modern Data & AI capabilities to quantified business outcomes.
* Align cross-functionally with FSRs and partners to execute joint Data+AI plays, driving platform standardization and co-sell motions.
* Whiteboard modern architectures (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, AlloyDB) to demonstrate how unified data foundations power high-performance, hallucination-free AI agents.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Tekniker inom kritisk kommunikation
description:
***Vill du arbeta med teknik som gör skillnad när det verkligen gäller?***




  





 På Celab arbetar vi med kommunikationsteknik som hjälper samhällsviktiga verksamheter att fungera, även i krävande situationer. Med snart 50 års erfarenhet, nya ägare och nytt ledarskap går vi nu in i en fas med ambitionen att vidareutveckla och stärka vår verksamhet.
 



  





 Till vårt team i Stockholm söker vi nu en tekniker som vill utvecklas tillsammans med oss. Här får du kombinera praktiskt tekniskt arbete med problemlösning, eget ansvar och möjligheten att lära dig nya tekniker.
 



  





 Du behöver inte kunna allt från början. Du kommer ett att erhålla en gedigen introduktion. Vi söker framför allt dig som har ett genuint teknikintresse, är nyfiken och vill fortsätta utvecklas.
 



  





**En varierad vardag med teknik i fokus** 




 Som tekniker på Celab arbetar du i första hand med konfigurering, installation, driftsättning och underhåll av kommunikationsutrustning och tekniska system. En betydande del av arbetet i Fruängen handlar om kommunikations- och säkerhetsutrustning i fordon.
 



  





 Du blir en del av vårt teknikteam och arbetar både självständigt och tillsammans med kollegor på olika tekniska uppdrag, antingen på vår anläggning i Fruängen eller ute hos våra kunder.
 



  





***Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat:***



* Installation och driftsättning av kommunikations- och säkerhetsutrustning, bland annat i fordon.
* Konfigurering och programmering av kommunikationsradio och annan teknisk utrustning.
* Felsökning, service och underhåll av produkter och system.
* Teknisk support och stöd till kunder och kollegor.



  





 Du kommer att arbeta med både etablerade och nyare kommunikationstekniker, exempelvis TETRA (Rakel), DMR, LTE och analoga radiosystem. På sikt kan även privata mobilnät bli aktuellt.
 



  





**Vem söker vi?** 




 Vi tror att du är en praktiskt lagd problemlösare med ett genuint teknikintresse. Du tycker om att arbeta med händerna, förstå tekniska samband och hitta lösningar när något inte fungerar som det ska.
 



 Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och trivs med ett arbete där du får kombinera självständighet med samarbete och kundkontakt.
 



  





***Vi ser gärna att du har:***



* Teknisk utbildning på gymnasie- eller eftergymnasial nivå, alternativt motsvarande praktisk erfarenhet.
* Grundläggande kunskaper inom elektronik, installation eller liknande tekniska områden.
* Ett intresse för radiokommunikation, nätverk och modern kommunikationsteknik.



  





 Har du erfarenhet av radioteknik, fordonselektronik, IP-kommunikation eller tekniska installationer är det meriterande.
 



  





*Det viktigaste är inte att du redan behärskar våra tekniker och produkter, utan att du har rätt grundkunskaper, inställning och vilja att lära dig.* 




  





 Du behöver ha B-körkort samt goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
 



  





**Vad får du hos Celab?** 




 Celab kombinerar det etablerade företagets erfarenhet och stabilitet med ambitionen att ständigt utvecklas. Med nya ägare och nytt ledarskap vill vi fortsätta utveckla både vårt erbjudande och vårt sätt att arbeta.
 



  





 För dig innebär det en möjlighet att inte bara utvecklas i ditt arbete, utan också bidra med idéer och initiativ till hur vi kan förbättra vårt arbete och vår verksamhet.
 



  





***Hos oss erbjuder vi:***



* **Teknik med betydelse.** 
 Arbeta med kommunikationslösningar för verksamheter där fungerande kommunikation är avgörande.
* **Variation och eget ansvar.** 
 En omväxlande arbetsdag med installation, konfigurering, felsökning och kunduppdrag.
* **Kompetens och utveckling.** 
 Lär av erfarna kollegor, bredda dina tekniska kunskaper och utvecklas i takt med verksamheten. För rätt person finns också möjlighet att avancera inom företaget.
* **Möjlighet att påverka.** 
 Vi vill bygga en företagskultur där idéer och förbättringsförslag tas tillvara, oavsett vem de kommer från.
* **Trygghet och gemenskap.** 
 Ett sammansvetsat team, kollektivavtal, arbetstidsförkortning, friskvårdsbidrag och gemensamma aktiviteter.



  





 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som tjänsteman på heltid med placering i Fruängen, Stockholm. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning.
 



  





**Låter det som något för dig?** 




 Skicka din ansökan till rekrytering@celab.se. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och ser gärna att du kan börja så snart som möjligt.
 



  





 Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Dennis Henningsson på 08-464 07 83 eller dennis.henningsson@celab.se. 
 



  





**Om Celab** 




 Celab Communications AB har arbetat med verksamhetskritisk kommunikation sedan 1978. Vi hjälper företag, myndigheter och samhällsviktiga verksamheter att kommunicera, samverka och arbeta effektivt även i krävande situationer.
 



  





 Med drygt 50 medarbetare i Kungälv, Stockholm och Karlstad kombinerar vi teknisk specialistkompetens med produkter, system och egenutvecklade applikationer. Vi hjälper våra kunder hela vägen från behovsanalys och projektering till installation, drift och support.
 



  





 Sedan 2025 ingår Celab i industrikoncernen Tången.

title: Customer Success Specialist - Finnish market | HR system implementation
description:
**About Hailey 🩷** 




 During the spring of 2020 Hailey HR was founded. We're a Swedish SaaS HR-tech company that want to digitalise, simplify and modernise the HR industry with our HR-system - join us on our journey!
 



  





**About the position 💼** 




 The Customer Success Specialist role is an entry-level position for new graduates, with growth opportunities into HR project management. You’ll become an expert in our HR system, represent HR departments’ needs internally, and help customers get the most out of the platform. Working as a team, we ensure our customers stay happy, engaged, and inspired to grow with us.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 As a Customer Success Specialist, you’ll work closely with our customers, proactively scheduling meetings and being available to support them by:
 



  




* Leading customers through the implementation of our HR system
* Onboarding and educating customers in using the system
* Keeping our knowledge base up to date for customers
* Managing the support chat and assisting with customer inquiries

title: Forskningsassistent inom cancerbioinformatik vid Karolinska Institutet
description:
****Vill du bidra till medicinsk forskning av toppkvalitet?****




**Vi söker en mycket motiverad forskningsassistent till vår forskargrupp inom cancerbioinformatik vid Karolinska Institutet.** 
 Vår forskning kombinerar artificiell intelligens, digital patologi och cancergenomik för att öka förståelsen av tumörbiologi och identifiera biomarkörer som kan förbättra patientvården. I detta projekt kommer du att arbeta med storskaliga histopatologiska bild- och genomikdata och använda avancerade beräkningsmetoder för att studera cancerrelaterade biologiska processer och cancerhallmarks i friska och tumörvävnader.
   

  





 Projektet genomförs i nära anslutning till SciLifeLab och TEF-Health (Testing and Experimentation Facility for Health), ett EU-finansierat initiativ inom Digital Europe-programmet som bygger en europeisk infrastruktur för testning och validering av AI och digitala teknologier inom hälso- och sjukvård. Karolinska Institutet och SciLifeLab utgör en central del av det svenska TEF-Health-konsortiet. Du blir en del av en tvärvetenskaplig och internationell forskningsmiljö vid BioClinicum och kommer att arbeta i samverkan med SciLifeLab och TEF-Health, med forskare inom bland annat cancerbiologi, bioinformatik, digital patologi och datavetenskap.
   

  





****Din roll****




 Du kommer att arbeta i ett forskningsprojekt som använder artificiell intelligens och metoder inom beräkningspatologi för att studera cancerbiologi med hjälp av storskaliga histopatologiska och genomiska datamängder. Projektet använder offentligt tillgängliga resurser såsom The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) och Genotype-Tissue GTEx) för att undersöka cancerhallmarks i friska och tumörvävnader.
   

  





 Arbetet omfattar analys av digitala patologibilder, tillämpning och utvärdering av djupinlärningsmodeller, integrering av bild- och genomikdata samt statistisk analys av kliniska utfall. Du kommer att bidra till utvecklingen av beräkningsflöden i Python och R samt genomföra analyser med hjälp av högpresterande beräkningsresurser.
   

  





 Arbetet kommer även att bidra till aktiviteter inom TEF-Health och SciLifeLab med fokus på testning, utvärdering och validering av AI-baserade metoder för hälsodata. SciLifeLab är en nationell infrastruktur för life science i Sverige som erbjuder avancerade teknologier och datadrivet forskningsstöd. Genom projektets koppling till SciLifeLab och TEF-Health får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö där AI, biomedicinsk forskning och utveckling av metoder för framtidens hälso- och sjukvård möts.
   

  





****Vem är du?****




 Du har en examen inom bioinformatik, datavetenskap, biostatistik, datalogi, biomedicinsk teknik, beräkningsbiologi eller ett närliggande område. Vi söker en motiverad, nyfiken och analytisk kollega med ett starkt intresse för artificiell intelligens, beräkningspatologi och cancerforskning. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  





**Krav och intressen:** 



* Starkt intresse för att tillämpa beräkningsmetoder på biomedicinska forskningsfrågor.
* Erfarenhet av programmering i Python och av att utveckla och anpassa beräkningsflöden för analys av biomedicinska data.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att tillämpa och utvärdera djupinlärningsmodeller för prediktion av genuttryck från digitala histopatologiska helglasbilder (whole-slide images, WSI).
* Erfarenhet av förbehandling av WSI, inklusive vävnadsmaskering, uppdelning i bildrutor (patches) och extraktion av bildrepresentationer (features)
* Erfarenhet av att sammanföra och analysera matchade histopatologiska bilder, RNA-seq-data och kliniska metadata från offentliga cancerdatabaser, såsom TCGA.
* Erfarenhet av kvantitativ jämförelse av modellprediktioner med uppmätta genuttrycksdata, exempelvis med korrelationsmått och prediktionsfel.
* Erfarenhet av statistisk analys i R, inklusive överlevnadsanalys med Kaplan-Meier-metoden och log-rank-test.
* Erfarenhet av att köra beräkningsflöden i Linuxmiljö på högpresterande beräkningssystem (HPC).
* God samarbetsförmåga och förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i grupp.
* Mycket god förmåga att kommunicera på engelska i tal och skrift.



**Meriterande:** 



* Praktisk erfarenhet av SEQUOIA, HE2RNA, Path2Space eller motsvarande modeller för prediktion av bulk- eller spatialt genuttryck från histopatologiska bilder.
* Erfarenhet av att beräkna och utvärdera genuttrycksbaserade signaturer, exempelvis CIN70, och analysera deras samband med kliniska utfall och tumöregenskaper.
* Erfarenhet av analys av bröstcancerdata, inklusive molekylära subtyper
* Erfarenhet av analys av normalvävnadsdata från GTEx eller av spatial prediktion av genuttryck.
* Erfarenhet av att anpassa befintliga modellimplementationer och hantera förtränade modellvikter och programvaruberoenden.
* Erfarenhet av GPU-baserad inferens och batchkörning av storskaliga bildanalyser på HPC.
* Erfarenhet av tvärvetenskapliga forskningsprojekt inom AI, hälsodata eller precisionsmedicin.



****Vad erbjuder vi?****




 En kreativ, internationell och inspirerande miljö fylld av kompetens och nyfikenhet. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. Vår vision är att driva utvecklingen av kunskap om livet och verka för en bättre hälsa för alla. Här bedriver vi framgångsrik medicinsk forskning och har det största utbudet av medicinska utbildningar i Sverige. Som universitet är Karolinska Institutet en statlig myndighet. Det gör att du får goda förmåner genom vårt kollektivavtal. Medarbetare på KI erbjuds också möjlighet till ett flexibelt arbetssätt. Det innebär att om den verksamhet du jobbar i tillåter, så kan du arbeta en del av din arbetstid på distans. Du får även träna fritt i våra moderna friskvårdsanläggningar där utbildad personal finns på plats.
   

  





**Placering:** 
*BioClinicum, Solna*




***Tio skäl att välja Karolinska Institutet* 
**Ansökan****




 KI tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt våra kollektivavtal RALS och RALS-T.
   

  





 Ansökan ska göras via rekryteringssystemet Varbi. I denna rekrytering söker du med ditt CV utan personligt brev. I ansökningsformuläret kommer du istället att få svara på några frågor om varför du söker jobbet.
   

  





 Detta är en tidsbegränsad anställning på 8 månader.
   

  





****Vill du göra skillnad – och bidra till en bättre hälsa för alla? Sök jobb hos oss****

title: Master Thesis: AI-Guided Pricing and Quoting for B2B Sales
description:
**Are you a master’s student looking for an innovative company to collaborate with on your master’s thesis during the spring semester of 2027? Look no further.**
 ASSA ABLOY is the global leader in access solutions and provides the latest technologies to give access to physical and virtual spaces for millions of people every day. Joining ASSA ABLOY means being part of a fast-moving and highly innovative company with diverse opportunities in more than 70 countries worldwide.
   

  

 What can you expect as a master’s thesis intern at ASSA ABLOY? Cutting edge technology, a steep learning curve, dedicated supervisors from within the enterprise, a group of fellow master's thesis students to share the experience with – and much more. We have an exciting range of subjects. Please remember to indicate in your application if you're interested in other subjects as well and mark them in your order of preference. Please also let us know your thoughts on how you would approach the subject. Please note that most of your work will be done at our site in Liljeholmen, Stockholm.
   

  

**Master Thesis Nr 4: AI-Guided Pricing and Quoting for B2B Sales**
 This thesis explores how artificial intelligence can support B2B sales teams in creating customer-specific quotes that are both fast to produce and commercially sound. Using the pricing and quoting process as a case study, the research will examine how AI-powered decision support can help configure offers and provide clear, explainable price guidance—such as a recommended price range—before a quote is sent to the customer.
   

  

 The project will explore how relevant commercial data—including customer characteristics, product configuration, historical transactions, discounts, deal outcomes, and market context—can be used to guide pricing decisions in real time, while balancing quote speed, pricing consistency, transparency, and commercial quality.
   

  

**Suggested Areas of Exploration:**
* What data and commercial signals are needed to generate reliable, customer-specific price guidance?
* How can an AI-based recommendation approach be designed so that its guidance is explainable and trusted by sales teams?
* How should pricing guidance be presented during quote configuration to support effective commercial decisions?
* What governance, approval logic, and guardrails are required when AI supports B2B pricing and quoting?
* How can the proposed approach be demonstrated through a context-appropriate prototype, such as a proof of concept, decision-support tool, or interactive mock-up?


**Expected Student Capabilities and Prior Knowledge:**
* Understanding of B2B sales, pricing, quoting, or CPQ processes is valuable.
* Knowledge of artificial intelligence, data science, business analytics, or decision-support methods.
* Interest in explainable AI and the practical adoption of AI-supported recommendations in commercial settings.
* Analytical and critical thinking skills, including the ability to structure complex problems, assess data objectively, and develop practical solutions.
* A relevant academic background, such as Industrial Engineering and Management, Data Science, Computer Science, AI, Business Analytics, or a similar field.


 We look forward to receiving your application with your resumé and hearing your ideas on how you would approach this subject!
   

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
 On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
   

  

 When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: PhD Research Intern, Efficient media delivery with Media over QUIC (MoQ)
description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a Flex Work approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.
   

  

 Start: January 2027
   

  

 Duration: 6 months

 This thesis project explores the cutting edge of media streaming by investigating Media over QUIC (MoQ), an emerging IETF protocol designed to overcome the limitations of today's streaming technologies. As the demand for low-latency, high-quality media experiences continues to grow, MoQ promises a unified framework capable of serving a wide range of use cases, from interactive streaming to large-scale broadcast events.
   

  

 The student will have the opportunity to get acquainted with the latest advances in media streaming, and to build upon a solid existing foundation in a professional, industry-leading environment. This project sits at the intersection of network protocol engineering, media systems, and real-world deployment challenges. The core deliverable of this project will be a proof-of-concept implementation utilizing MoQ and an evaluation of the resulting system.
   

  

**By working on this project, the student will:**
* Gain deep expertise in modern network transport protocols
* Develop practical implementation skills by working with real protocol specifications and open-source tooling
* Build experience in system evaluation and performance analysis
* Get exposure to industry-standard workflows and practices

**Sambla Group is a fintech company with a clear goal – to be your trusted financial partner. We’ve grown into one of the fastest-growing fintech companies, bridging the gap between borrowers and lenders, thanks to the 500+ amazing people who work here. In the summer of 2026, we were granted authorisation as a credit market company, marking an important milestone in our continued journey to expand into own lending and opening an exciting new chapter for Sambla Group.**
 At Sambla Group, we are building the next phase of our business: a broader, more tech-enabled personal finance ecosystem across the Nordics. We combine technology, data and human expertise to help people make smarter financial choices through life’s turns.
   

  

 Now we are looking for our next CRM Analytics & Experimentation Lead
 **.** 
 This position is based at our headquarters in Stockholm, located at Tulegatan 4.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own CRM measurement and performance insights across markets**
* Lead the measurement agenda for CRM and Retention across Sambla Group’s markets, helping us understand what drives customer value, commercial performance, and long-term growth.
* Define clear success metrics for CRM initiatives, from campaign-level KPIs to lifecycle, retention, incrementality, and profitability measures.
* Build and continuously improve reporting, dashboards, and performance routines that turn customer and campaign data into clear recommendations.
* Identify opportunities, risks, and performance gaps across the customer lifecycle, and translate them into concrete actions for CRM, Marketing, Product, Sales, and local market teams.


**Build a structured experimentation framework**
* Own the CRM experimentation framework, including test design, hypothesis creation, audience selection, measurement methodology, and learning agenda.
* Define when and how we use A/B testing, holdout groups, incrementality testing, uplift measurement, and other approaches to understand true business impact.
* Create scalable ways of documenting, sharing, and reusing learnings across markets so that insights compound over time.


**Turn data into decisions**
* Analyze customer behavior, CRM journeys, campaign performance, and lifecycle movements to uncover actionable insights.
* Translate complex data and experimentation results into sharp, business-oriented recommendations that help teams prioritize the highest-impact opportunities.


**Enable AI-powered CRM optimization**
* Define how AI-driven initiatives should be measured, tested, and evaluated to ensure they create real incremental impact.
* Act as a bridge between business goals, OKRs (Objectives, Key Results), analytical methods, and practical CRM execution, making advanced capabilities useful and actionable for the team.


**Who You Are**
 We believe you are someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data, customer behaviour and commercial impact. You have strong experience in CRM analytics, marketing analytics, experimentation, customer insights or a similar role, preferably in a multi-market, fintech, subscription, marketplace or other performance-driven environment.
   

  

 You have at least 2-3 years work experience and a solid understanding of CRM, retention, lifecycle marketing and customer journeys. You know how to measure what creates real value for both customers and the business. You are highly analytical and comfortable working with customer data, campaign data, dashboards and performance reporting, while also being able to turn complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
   

  

**To Succeed In This Role, We Believe You Bring**
* Experience in designing and evaluating experiments, such as A/B tests, holdout groups, incrementality measurement and clear success metrics.
* A commercial mindset, with an understanding of how CRM initiatives connect to revenue, profitability, retention, customer lifetime value and long-term growth.
* The ability to communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders across functions, including explaining analytical concepts in a simple and relevant way.
* Curiosity about AI and an interest in using data, automation and AI-powered capabilities to improve CRM reporting and performance.
* A growth mindset: curious, proactive, structured and eager to test, learn, iterate and continuously improve how we work.
* Experience with tools such as SQL, BI platforms, CRM or marketing automation platforms, web analytics or experimentation platforms is a strong advantage.


**What We Offer**
**We might be a little different from most companies. Instead of defining personal values, we’ve built a shared way of working - a rhythm that guides how we collaborate, support our customers, and move forward together.** 
**We call it Drive & Jive - a shared rhythm that creates momentum through direction, collaboration, and human connection.**
*As part of our recruitment process, we always carry out a background check before extending a job offer.*
 Sambla Group is the new generation of brokers. Our ambition has always been the same - to challenge the banks’ offers so that our customers, regardless of the conditions, should always have the same opportunity to obtain the best possible loan solution. Sambla Group has grown to over 500 employees, established itself in Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark with offices in all markets.

title: Sr Manager, Customer Success EMEA
description:
Sinch's vision is to connect every business with every customer, everywhere in the world. More than 200,000 businesses - including Google, Uber, Paypal, Visa, Tinder, and many others - rely on Sinch's Customer Communications Cloud to power engaging customer experiences through mobile messaging, voice, and email.
 



  





 Whether you need to verify users or craft omnichannel campaigns, Sinch makes it easy. Our AI-infused Super Network, APIs, and applications ensure you can connect with your customers reliably and securely, at every step of their journey.
 



  





 At Sinch we "Dream Big", "Win Together", "Keep it simple", and "Make it Happen". These values are our foundation!
 



  





**Description** 




 Sinch is building a Customer Success organization to support its enterprise customers across EMEA. We're looking for a leader to join the regional CS leadership team, reporting to the VP of Customer Success EMEA.
 



  





 You'll lead a cross-regional team of Customer Success Managers. Some are experienced colleagues moving over from Account Management, and some will be new hires. You'll be accountable for the health, retention and growth of your customer portfolio. Because the function is new, you'll also help shape how it works: the processes, playbooks and ways of working, built with your peer leaders. You'll work closely with our global Onboarding and Customer Excellence teams, as well as Support, Billing and other internal functions, to create a seamless customer experience and remove obstacles to customer success. That includes figuring out, together, how automation and AI change the job.
 



  





**Key responsibilities:** 




  





**Lead your team** 



* Lead, coach and develop a cross-regional team of CSMs. Help team members moving from commercial roles to become strong CSMs, and hire where there are gaps.
* Set clear expectations and build a habit of proactive, data-led customer management.
* Act as the escalation point and executive sponsor for your most strategic customers.
* Be accountable for your team's Net Revenue Retention, churn and renewal outcomes. Every account is owned by a CSM, and your job is to make that ownership work.
* Run the team's rhythm: health reviews, risk forecasting, business review quality, follow-through on escalations.
* Step in as executive sponsor for strategic customers and critical escalations.
* Make sure expansion signals reach Account Management, and that customer feedback reaches Product.



  





**Build the function** 



* Co-create EMEA CS processes and playbooks with the VP and your peer leaders: health scoring, engagement cadences, business reviews, escalation paths.
* Make handoffs work with global Onboarding, Customer Excellence, Account Management, Sales Engineering and Support.
* Bring practical ideas on automation and AI. Run experiments with your team, measure what works, and share it across the function. We don't have all the answers yet, and we want you to help find them.



  





 The role can be based in any of our locations in Prague, Munich, Stockholm or London and report to the VP, Customer Success EMEA. Regular travel will be required.
 



  





**Requirements** 



* Deep, hands-on Customer Success experience. You've worked as a CSM yourself, and you've led CS teams for several (5+) years in B2B SaaS, CPaaS or another API/usage-based business.
* Delivered results: you've owned NRR, churn and renewal targets for enterprise customers, and you can show the numbers.
* Experience building, not just running: you've introduced playbooks, health scoring or new ways of working, ideally while bringing people in from other roles.
* Curiosity about AI and automation, with at least one real example of how you used it to change how you or your team work.
* Technical fluency: you're comfortable with APIs, usage data and integrations, and credible with customer product and engineering teams.
* Comfortable working across a matrix organization and across regions, and getting things done through influence.
* Experience with Salesforce and a CS platform (Gainsight or similar).
* Fluent English. German and other European languages are a plus.



  





**Our hiring process** 




 We are committed to ensuring a recruitment process that is fair, objective, consistent, and inclusive. Our approach includes structured, competency-based interviews designed to evaluate your skills, experience, and qualifications relevant to the role. At times, we may include a data-driven assessment to enhance our hiring success and identify candidates likely to excel.
 



  





 We believe in a two-way process and encourage you to ask questions throughout the journey. If this role isn't what you're looking for, please explore the other opportunities listed on our career page: https://www.sinch.com/careers/. No matter who you are, we hope you find an exciting path forward - hopefully with us!
 



  





**Salary** 




 The annual salary for this position is between SEK 775.000 – 975.000. This role is also eligible for bonus. Factors which may affect pay within this range may include skills, education, experience, and other qualifications

title: Vikariat upphandlare/e-handel till Upplands Väsby kommun

 Vi erbjuder dig en spännande och dynamisk arbetsmiljö där din skicklighet som upphandlare inom e-handel verkligen kan blomstra! I detta vikariat får du chansen att jobba med ett engagerat team som värdesätter struktur, nyfikenhet och förmågan att skapa relationer. Hos oss kommer du att få:

 Är du strukturerad, vetgirig och har en talang för att skapa relationer? Då kan du vara den vi söker! I rollen som vikariat upphandlare/e-handel kommer du att spela en central roll i vårt team och bidra till att optimera våra upphandlingsprocesser med fokus på e-handel.

 Om detta låter som en spännande möjlighet för dig, ser vi fram emot att ta del av din ansökan och lära känna dig bättre!
