title: Marketing Manager B2B
description:
At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT.
   

  

 Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognized as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.
   

  

 Our values – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple and Act Cost-efficiently – guide our culture, how we collaborate and how we turn ideas into action.
   

  

**About The Job**
*As a Marketing Manager within Tele2 B2B, you will lead and drive the operational delivery of integrated marketing activities and campaigns. Organizationally, this role sits within the B2C Marketing department, collaborating closely with B2B stakeholders. Your primary mission is to ensure that our initiatives are executed efficiently, on time, and with maximum commercial impact and lead generation. In this dynamic, operational role, you will support the Marketing Lead in translating overarching strategy into high-performing marketing execution.* 
 This is a 7 months substitute for parental leave.
   

  

**Your key responsibilities and tasks:**
* Lead, plan, and execute end-to-end delivery of B2B marketing campaigns and Go-to-Market (GTM) activities – from initial briefing to follow-up.
* Design, build, and optimize email marketing as well as automated communication (lead-nurturing workflows) across the customer journey using our MarTech stack and email marketing platform.
* Produce and oversee engaging B2B content and copy across digital channels, including articles, guides, customer success stories, email copy, and sales enablement assets.
* Partner closely with Commercial, Sales, CVM, PR, Online, In-house Studio, and external creative/media agencies to ensure cohesive messaging and aligned execution.
* Continuously monitor, analyze, and report on campaign KPIs, inbound lead generation, traffic, and marketing ROI to identify growth and optimization opportunities.
* Plan and coordinate campaign deliverables, production schedules, and budgets to ensure on-time delivery against commercial targets.


**Who are you?**
 To thrive and succeed in this role, we believe that you are a structured, hands-on, and commercial driven Marketing Manager who excels in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.
   

  

*Mandatory qualifications:*
* 3+ years of B2B-experience in marketing.
* 3+ years within project management. Proven track record in end-to-end project management, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders and external agencies.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with marketing automation, email marketing, and MarTech tools. Designing, setting up, and optimizing ad-hoc and automated communication and lead-nurturing flows across the customer journey.
* Strong commercial mindset and experience optimizing campaign delivery against established KPIs.
* Good copywriting skills with a demonstrated ability to create high-quality, engaging content.
* Professional fluency in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.


 You are proactive, independent, and structured, with a strong ability to prioritize tasks effectively in an evolving environment. You are a natural relationship builder who collaborates effortlessly across diverse teams and is motivated by delivering tangible results.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Pension and health care
   

  

 Hybrid and flexible work life balance
   

  

 Career opportunities
   

  

 Parental benefit
   

  

 Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
   

  

 Inclusive workplace

title: Account Executive - Sweden - Nordics
description:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.
 



 What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.
 



 Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.
 



 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
 
 our wins – big and small.
 



 Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!
 



 Anaplan is seeking an
 **ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE** 
 in Sweden, to drive its growth and expand its presence in the Nordics area.
 



 In this role, you will take your proven track record of selling sophisticated technology solutions and account management and sell an incredibly versatile platform. Our sales team is helping industry leaders understand the impact of Anaplan products and how our connected planning solution is ending siloed decision-making. You will help our customers achieve their immediate business goals while setting their business up for the future.
 



 This role will be a catalyst to Anaplan’s continued growth while leading digital transformation. Reporting directly to the RVP of Sales. You will have mostly greenfield accounts. This type of territory requires someone to further build our footprint by hunting and locking in new logo accounts as well as rapidly growing opportunities within the current customer base.
 



**Your Impact** 



* Engaging with targeted prospects to identify broken business processes and position Anaplan’s unique ability to solve the problem,
* Build Anaplan’s business value throughout the selling engagement. Navigating sophisticated prospect environments to align the prospect around the Anaplan solution,
* Conduct highly effective presentations from Director through SVP and key C-suite level decision makers including CFOs, CROs, and senior leaders in supply chain, workforce, and other business functions,
* Develop customers and own opportunity management start-to-finish across multiple customer targets and functions,
* Apply Anaplan’s value-based selling methodology and tools to run sales processes and accurately forecast business,
* Employ outstanding account leadership skills to identify account expansion opportunities by cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within targeted accounts,
* Perform strategic sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business,
* Work with cross-functional members of Sales Development Reps, Marketing, Solution Consultants, and the Customer Success teams.



**Your Qualifications** 



* Extensive experience in consultative sales to Fortune 2000 companies, ideally in SaaS solutions Enterprise Software
* 'Hunter' with a strong growth mindset, motivated by developing new business essential
* Experience in Industrial verticals, Retail, Energy, Manufacturing and Business preferred
* Shown success selling into Vice President / Senior Vice President buyers,
* Track record of overachieving sales quota & targets, including demonstrated history of multiple high six-figure annual contract value (ACV) deals (services and/or software),
* Demonstrated network in your industry territory, with a mix of some customers and implementation partners,
* Demonstrated experience with sophisticated partner & internal team organisations,
* Domain understanding (Supply Chain, FP&A, Workforce Planning & Sales) and knowledge of how these functions plan, process work and make decisions,
* Strong, demonstrated opportunity management practices (e.g. sales process, qualification, executive presentation skills, quote presentation and negotiation), and ability to balance multiple (3-5) opportunities at once,
* Business, Finance, Economics, related BS/BA degree or relevant years of experience.
* Fluency in Swedish and English



**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience with Outreach, SFDC, LinkedIn Sales Navigator a plus,
* Account Planning experience Altify, MEDDPICC, Miller Heiman.
* Based In sweden, understands Enterprise Sales SAAS market



**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** 




 We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!
 



 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.  
 



**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** 
  
 



 It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.
 



 Anaplan does not:  
 


* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.



 All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.   
 



**Privacy & AI
 

 Notice**





 C
 

 andidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled
 

 in accordance with
 

 our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to
 

 assist
 

 our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Founding GTM, Sweden
description:
All open roles
   

  

 Go-to-Market
   

  

 Founding GTM, Sweden
   

  

 Stockholm, Sweden
   

  

* Full-time Apply for this role


 We think every business owner should be able to sell to every customer who wants to buy, get paid for it on time, and still make it feel effortless for the customer — without having to build a call centre to do it. That's why we built Sono.
   

  

**About Us**
 Sono builds Voice AI agents that handle customer communication at scale, outbound and inbound, over voice and text. We make sure our customers can call every customer and answer every call, even in the most complex situations and at scale.
   

  

 Voice AI is one of the fastest emerging technologies in the world. It's easy to build beautiful demos, but hard to meet top enterprises' quality criteria in production. That's where we excel. Our technology is built for the hard cases: conversations where money and trust are on the line — payment reminders and collection calls, customer reactivation, service bookings, inbound support. Our agents stay inside the rules they're given, and every call outcome is visible to the customer.
   

  

 Today we have more than 20 customers with agents live in six countries. With customer service agents, we consistently see resolution rates above 70%; our payment reminder agents secure payments from 35–40% of engaged customers. We're seed stage, backed by top Nordic investors.
   

  

 The customers we have love us. There just aren't enough of them yet — and that's what we're hiring for.
   

  

 Working with us
   

  

 This is an end-to-end sales job: prospecting, cold calling, pitching, closing, wins and losses, all of it together. You'll work side-by-side with our co-founder and CEO in the Stockholm office, building the business across the Nordic countries.
   

  

 What you'll be doing
   

  

* Bringing in new business: net new customers across Sweden and the rest of Northern Europe.
* Building your own pipeline, running discovery and closing deals.
* Taking your learnings back to the team. We're small, so whoever sits closest to the customer has real influence over what we build and how we sell it.


 Who we're looking for
   

  

* 2 to 5 years in B2B sales, preferably in tech or SaaS.
* You know how to create your own pipeline. You enjoy calling a customer and getting them hooked on the value we can create.
* You've closed deals. In your mind, nothing beats ringing the closing bell (and seeing the commission hit your bank account).
* You enjoy competition and strive to win. You've hit or beaten a quota somewhere and can tell us by how much.
* You are ambitious and work hard. We are building a European category-winner. This is your chance to join early and play a key role in the journey.
* Swedish at native level, full professional proficiency in English.
* Based in Stockholm and happy to be in the office every day.


 The following is considered a plus
   

  

* Fluency in Finnish, Danish, Norwegian, or other European languages.
* You've worked at an early-stage startup and/or with AI products.
* You've worked with large enterprises and have an existing rolodex of strong connections of potential customers.
* AI-nativeness and fluency with the latest tools.


 What we offer
   

  

* Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions. If you help us win, we'll make sure you win too.
* Meaningful equity. You're joining early and deserve your share of the upside.
* A product that doesn't churn. We've never lost a customer, and most expand — we're solving an operational bottleneck businesses actually have, not just chasing a hot category.
* The founders next to you every day, with an opportunity to grow with the company.
* Top-tier equipment and all the latest tools to help you close business as effectively as possible.


 How to apply
   

  

 Send us your CV and a few lines on three questions:
   

  

* How have you built pipeline from nothing before? What did you actually do, and what came of it?
* What's the hardest deal you've helped close, and what was your part in it?
* What's the achievement you're the proudest of? What did you do, and why did you choose that?


 Sound like you?
   

  

 Send your CV and your answers to the three questions above. We read every application and get back to you in 3 days.
   

  

 Apply for this role
   

  

 Other open roles
   

  

* Forward Deployed Engineer
* Founding GTM, Netherlands
* Founding GTM, Poland

title: Customer Experience Agent
description:
**Juni who? 👋**
 At Juni, we’re busy building the future of banking. We want to help businesses do more with less and get access to the financial tools they need to operate, grow, and win globally.
   

  

**How & Why We Do It 🚀**
 We give our people the same thing we’re building for our customers: freedom. Freedom to be 100% yourself. Freedom to explore your potential and what’s more – make the most of it. We truly believe we’re making the world a better place for online businesses, and we want you to be a part of that mission.
   

  

**Your Role At a Glance**
 As a Customer Experience Agent at Juni, you’ll be part of our Product organisation, joining the Customer Success function alongside our Onboarding and Customer Retention teams. You’ll deliver exceptional support and experiences to our customers while working closely with Product, Engineering, and Commercial teams to help improve both our product and customer experience. You’ll be the first point of contact for inbound inquiries, resolving issues with empathy, clarity, and efficiency.
   

  

 Every interaction you have helps shape how customers experience Juni. Your work directly contributes to customer trust, loyalty, and continuous product improvement as we scale.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities 👏**
**In this role, you’ll:**
**Deliver exceptional customer support**
* Manage inbound customer conversations across Intercom chat and email.
* Resolve customer inquiries accurately, efficiently, and with empathy.
* Triage and escalate urgent or high-risk issues, including fraud and critical payment incidents.
* Deliver clear, consistent, and professional communication in every interaction.
* Ensure customer conversations are accurately documented and tagged.
* Collaborate across teams to resolve complex customer issues.
* Meet service standards while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.


**Drive continuous improvement**
* Identify recurring customer issues and share actionable insights with Product, Engineering, Commercial, and Leadership teams.
* Act as the voice of the customer by surfacing trends and opportunities to improve the customer experience.

title: Systemspecialist OT & Automation- Projektteknik
description:
*Vill du göra en verklig skillnad för att Sverige ska lyckas med energiomställningen och nå klimatmålen? Vi kommer att göra stora investeringar i vårt nät och söker nu Systemspecialist med kompetens inom OT och automation till våra projekt.*
 Vi är i en historisk omställning och står inför en omfattande elektrifiering av samhället. Ett sätt vi gör detta på är att utöka de investeringar vi gör i vårt elnät. För att kunna göra detta behöver vi bli fler engagerade medarbetare inom enheten Anläggningsinvestering som arbetar med våra investeringsprojekt inom lokal- och regionnät.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Systemspecialist inom OT och automation hos oss lovar vi att du kommer utmanas i spännande och komplexa frågeställningar. Avdelningen Projektteknik ansvarar för att säkerställa tekniskt innehåll i planering, genomförande av anläggningsinvesteringar och levererar anläggningsteknisk specialistkompetens till verksamheten. Med tekniken i fokus är vi involverade i arbetet som tar fram praktiska lösningar på tekniska utmaningar inom drift, utveckling och anläggningsbyggnation.
   

  

 Ditt huvudsakliga ansvar blir att stå för specialistkompetens till investeringsverksamheten, vilket innebär att agera teknisk resurs i våra projekt. Dina arbetsuppgifter består bland annat av:
   

  

* Säkerställa kvaliteten på de nya anläggningarna och att anläggningsutformningen är optimal.
* Medverka vid anbudsutvärdering gällande stationens tekniska funktioner.
* Granska teknisk konstruktion samt kontrollera utformning vid fabrikstest.
* Agera ansvarig representant vid idrifttagningsprovning och idrifttagningar samt säkerställa att anläggningen uppfyller kraven i den tekniska specifikationen och Vattenfalls Tekniska Riktlinjer.
* Samverka med övriga avdelningar inom enheten Anläggningsinvestering.


 Resor till närliggande projekt förekommer samt eventuellt enstaka resor till utlandet.
   

  

 Kvalifikationer
   

  

 Vi söker dig som trivs i en roll där du får använda din analytiska förmåga och samarbeta tillsammans med andra. Du drivs av nyfikenhet och vill ständigt lära dig mer kopplat till teknik och hur tekniken kan användas på bästa sätt för att kunna agera bra tekniskt stöd i projekt.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
 Du har
   

  

* Eftergymnasial utbildning, gärna på högskoleingenjörsnivå med inriktning mot automation, el/tele, datakommunikation och nätverk, IT/OT. Till exempel Elektroingenjör, Automationsingenjör, Datateknik eller motsvarande kunskap genom tidigare erfarenhet.
* Lätt för att utrycka dig i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska
* Körkort klass B


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av
   

  

* Har kunskap och erfarenhet från arbete med fjärrkontrollterminaler, HMI:er, PLC- programmering, switchar, routrar, nätverk och tillhörande förvaltning.
* Grundläggande kunskaper i ellära, elkraftssystem, processautomation, IEC 61850, IP-baserade kommunikationslösningar eller projektledning.


 Ytterligare information
   

  

**Vi Erbjuder**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en företagskultur där vi strävar efter att vara öppna, aktiva och positiva med arbetsuppgifter som utvecklar och utmanar dig. Våra medarbetares och samarbetspartners hälsa och välbefinnande är viktig för oss. En god arbetsmiljö är grundläggande i allt vi gör och säkerheten står alltid i centrum. För oss är det viktigt att dina personliga värderingar stämmer överens med vår kultur som präglas av att göra varandra bättre, ligga steget före samt att hålla vad vi lovar.
   

  

 För att du ska trivas erbjuder vi möjlighet till ständigt lärande, bra arbetsvillkor och ett brett utbud av personalförmåner.  Läs mer om våra förmåner här.
   

  

**Placeringsort**
 Solna, Västerås, Linköping eller Uppsala
   

  

 För mer information om tjänsten kontakta anställande chef Jakob Heinerud Jonsson 070-331 83 06, jakob.jonsson@vattenfall.com
   

  

 För frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kontakta rekryterare Jessica Petersson, jessica.petersson@vattenfall.com
   

  

 Fackliga representanter för denna tjänst är Christian Ericsson, Ledarna, Anne-Marie Sjöbohm, Akademikerna, Jan-Olof Eriksson, Unionen, Ulf Tengman, SEKO. Alla kontaktpersoner nås via Vattenfalls växel 08-739 50 00.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 8 november 2026** 
 Vi tar inte emot personligt brev i ansökan. Du söker snabbt och enkelt genom att svara på urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår webbplats. Urval och intervjuer sker efter sista ansökningsdag. I den här rekryteringsprocessen kommer tester att förekomma.
   

  

*Att arbeta inom Vattenfall innebär att arbeta med samhällsviktig infrastruktur. Därmed är många av våra tjänster säkerhetsklassade och du kan komma att bli krigsplacerad. Är denna tjänst säkerhetsklassad kommer säkerhetsprövning genomföras innan anställning, i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagen. En eventuell krigsplacering sker med stöd i anställningsavtalet och lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.
   

  

 På Vattenfall värdesätter vi att vara aktiva, positiva, öppna och säkerhetsmedvetna. Vi söker medarbetare som delar vår vision och kan bidra till att stärka vår företagskultur. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald bidrar till att bygga ett mer lönsamt och tilltalande företag och strävar efter att vara goda förebilder när det gäller mångfald. Vattenfall arbetar aktivt för att alla medarbetare ska ha samma möjligheter och rättigheter oavsett ålder, etnisk eller kulturell bakgrund, könstillhörighet, religion/tro, sexuell läggning eller funktionsvariation. Läs mer om hur vi arbetar med mångfald och inkludering här.*

 Vattenfall Eldistribution AB är Vattenfalls elnätsverksamhet och ett av Sveriges största elnätsföretag. Vi ansvarar för en samhällsbärande infrastruktur som distribuerar el till mer än 900 000 företag och hushåll. Som medarbetare hos oss bidrar du varje dag till att samhället fungerar och till en säker elförsörjning för kommande generationer. Tillsammans bygger vi framtidens elnät och möjliggör omställningen till ett hållbart samhälle. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta här

title: Senior Business Development Manager | Locker Network
description:
**Are you ready to shape and lead the strategic commercial expansion for one of the market’s fastest-growing parcel locker networks?**
 As our
 **Senior Business Development Manager | Locker Network** 
 , you will be a key driver behind our group-wide growth. In this pivotal role, you will shape and execute our network expansion strategy, cultivate high-value B2B partnerships, and equip local market teams with the frameworks, tools, and best practices needed to lead in their respective markets.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Your core mission is to build sustainable commercial momentum across all markets. You will bridge high-level strategy with hands-on enablement—ranging from supporting local sales teams in securing contracts with major international retail accounts to establishing scalable "Ways of Working" that empower local sales teams to exceed their goals.
   

  

 You will be part of the central Group Network team, working closely alongside Country Managers and local Network Managers as a strategic partner, advisor, and enabler.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Group-Level Business Development & Key Accounts: Support markets in building long-term, deep partnerships with major strategic accounts. Develop compelling commercial concepts and value propositions that establish us as a preferred partner.
* Strategy & Target Alignment: Translate group-level growth strategies into clear priorities and targets for local teams. Drive engagement, momentum, and shared success across markets through close collaboration with local sales leaders.
* Effective "Ways of Working": Identify high-performing local practices and scale them across the group. Build best-in-class commercial toolkits, including pitch decks, value proposition case studies, partner insight, and sales training modules.
* Local Team Enablement & Sounding Board: Serve as a trusted advisor to local leadership and sales teams. Help markets structure their commercial setups, navigate complex contract negotiations, and refine sales tactics.
* Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning: Stay ahead of industry trends, competitor network developments, and location dynamics. Capture local insights to ensure strategy and resources remain aligned with market realities.


 Who You Are
   

  

 We are looking for a senior commercial leader with strong business acumen and a track record of driving sales results. You thrive in international environments, excel at building scalable frameworks from the ground up, and lead naturally through collaboration, trust, and influence rather than top-down authority.
   

  

**What You Bring**
* Demonstrated experience in B2B business development, enterprise sales, or strategic Key Account Management at a senior level.
* Proven ability in driving commercial success through one or several teams.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a collaborative leadership style that inspires and aligns cross-functional teams.


**Nice To Have (but Not Required)**
* Experience acquiring space or negotiating partnerships within retail, real estate, or public/logistics infrastructure.


*Don't check every single box? If you have strong B2B commercial leadership experience and are excited about driving cross-market growth, we strongly encourage you to apply.*
 What you'll get
   

  

 We can promise you'll be challenged, grow fast, and work alongside genuinely excellent people. If you like shaking things up and building new ways of working from scratch — this is your place.
   

  

**Beyond The Usual Essentials, We've Also Got**
 🏢
 **Brand-New Office** 
 : More Space for Our Brilliant People. Soon moving into our new Stockholm HQ, designed to bring our people together to collaborate, connect, create and deliver.
   

  

 🐶
 **Dog-Friendly Office:** 
 Dogs are welcome in designated dog-friendly rooms within the office.
   

  

 🏓
 **Fun & Games:** 
 Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and a private Karaoke Room.
   

  

 👶
 **Parental Top-Up:** 
 6 months of parental pay support so you can focus on your family.
   

  

 🎂
 **Birthday Off:** 
 Enjoy your special day on us with an extra day off every year.
   

  

 ⏰
 **Flexible Hybrid Setup:** 
 Working hours designed to adapt to your life.
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion matter deeply to us. We are committed to building a workplace where every perspective is valued, different leadership styles thrive, and everyone has room to grow.
   

  

 How to Apply
   

  

**Ready to take the next step in your career? Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible!**
 Note on our process:
 *As part of our commitment to maintaining a safe and trustworthy workplace, all candidates applying to Instabee in Sweden will undergo a background check conducted by Svensk Bakgrundsanalys. This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

 I rollen kommer du att vara en nyckelperson i arbetet med att utveckla och stärka Vattenfall Eldistributions förmåga att möta våra kunders behov. title: Cloudkunnig Technical Account Manager
description:
Vill du vara nyckelpersonen som skapar långsiktiga kundrelationer och hjälper företag att maximera värdet av sina IT-lösningar? Eccera söker nu en Technical Account Manager (TAM) till vår kund i Stockholm. Kunden är ett driftbolag med ca 150 kunder som behöver stärka upp teamet med en Cloudkunnig TAM som vill arbeta tekniskt hands on.
 



  





 Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.
 



  





**Dina arbetsuppgifter** 




  





**Kundrelationer** 



* Vara primär teknisk kontaktperson för utvalda strategiska kunder.
* Bygga och upprätthålla långsiktiga relationer på både teknisk och affärsmässig nivå.
* Fungera som kundens förespråkare internt och säkerställa att deras behov lyfts fram.



**Tekniskt ansvar** 



* Genomföra regelbundna tekniska genomgångar, “health checks” och uppföljningar.
* Rådgiva kunder kring bästa praxis för att optimera användningen av våra lösningar.
* Stödja vid implementationer, integrationer och förändringsprojekt.
* Hantera eskaleringar och koordinera incidenthantering tillsammans med interna support- och utvecklingsteam.



**Strategiskt ansvar** 



* Identifiera förbättrings- och utvecklingsmöjligheter hos kunden.
* Bidra till kundens långsiktiga IT-strategi genom rådgivning och lösningsförslag.
* Samarbeta nära säljorganisationen för att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter.
* Bidra till produktutveckling genom att förmedla kundfeedback till interna team.



**Rapportering & uppföljning** 



* Dokumentera aktiviteter och leverera rapporter till kunder och interna intressenter.
* Säkerställa att SLA och KPI:er uppfylls.
* Driva kundmöten och QBR (Quarterly Business Reviews).



  





**Din profil** 




  





**Tekniska kvalifikationer** 



* Djup förståelse för IT-infrastruktur, nätverk och säkerhetslösningar.
* Djup kunskap och erfarenhet av M365, Intune och Azure.
* Kunskap om dataskydd och compliance (t.ex. GDPR, ISO27001).
* Vana vid ITIL-processer (Incident, Problem, Change, Service Request).
* Förmåga att snabbt sätta sig in i nya teknologier och lösningar.



**Erfarenhet** 



* 3–5 års erfarenhet i en kundnära teknisk roll (t.ex. TAM, IT-konsult, Pre-Sales, Service Manager).
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta med företagskunder inom IT-branschen.
* Erfarenhet av projektledning eller större implementationer är meriterande.
* Förmåga att presentera tekniskt komplexa lösningar på ett enkelt och affärsmässigt sätt.

title: Senior IT-arkitekt inom molninfrastruktur
description:

 Som konsult på Eccera får du en trygg anställning och samlar på dig värdefull arbetslivserfarenhet på uppdrag hos våra kunder. Din konsultchef stöttar dig i din utveckling där du hela tiden fyller på med nya erfarenheter och kunskaper. En utmärkt möjlighet att göra karriär.

title: Data Engineer with a Focus on Data Modelling – Finance & Risk Data Platform | SEB, Solna
description:
Are you an experienced Data Engineer with deep expertise in enterprise data warehouse design and data modelling, preferably with experience in Data Vault 2.0? Join us in transforming our existing GCP data platform into an advanced enterprise data warehouse that reliably integrates diverse data sources and helps shape the future of finance.
   

  

 SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. Cloud, AI, automation and modern engineering are natural parts of how we build, operate and continuously improve our technology platforms. From core banking platforms to hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, platform engineering, AI-enabled operations and automation, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future-proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

**About The Role**
 You will play a key role in transforming SEB’s Finance & Risk Data Platform into a modern, scalable, and audit-ready enterprise data warehouse. This is a hands-on data engineering role with a particular focus on enterprise data modelling. As part of the FR360 Data Platform team, you will help establish a data architecture that enables reliable integration at enterprise scale while meeting the high standards of a regulated banking environment.
   

  

 Your primary focus will be designing and implementing robust data models that support business reporting, regulatory requirements, historical data management, and data governance. You will work closely with data engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and Finance & Risk specialists to ensure that data is accurate, traceable, and fit for purposes.
   

  

**Key responsibilities include:**
* Take end-to-end responsibility for data modelling, from source analysis to the design and implementation of target data models.
* Use SQL and other analytical techniques to understand source data structures, content, relationships, keys, grain, and data quality.
* Design target data models using scalable and maintainable patterns based on Data Vault 2.0 principles and methodologies.
* Define and promote standards for historical data management, auditability, lineage, metadata management, and data quality.
* Build and optimise ELT processes using Google Cloud Platform technologies, including BigQuery, Cloud Composer, dbt, and Dataform.
* Drive best practices in data modelling, warehouse design, and engineering excellence across the team.


 You will share responsibility for the team’s day-to-day data engineering work while taking a leading role in data modelling, data governance, and data engineering standards.
   

  

**To thrive in this role, we believe you have:**
* Deep expertise in data modelling and enterprise data warehouse design.
* Proven hands-on experience delivering data models end to end, from requirements gathering and source analysis through conceptual and logical modelling to physical design and production implementation.
* A track record of building scalable data platforms that integrate large numbers of heterogeneous source systems.

 As an Agentic Data Cloud Sales Specialist Manager, you will lead a team responsible for growing our Agentic Data Cloud business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers.  Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry.  Om NCSC och FRA

Just nu är NCSC i en expansiv utvecklingsfas där du får möjlighet att vara med och bygga upp en central kontaktpunkt för Sveriges cybersäkerhet.
   

  

 Som nyanställd på FRA får du en omfattande introduktionsutbildning och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling, vilket ger dig möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter och bli ännu bättre på det du brinner för. title: Sales Development Representative | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will focus on three core missions. One, you will help our users and prospects navigate their Grafana journey by engaging with and listening to them in order to provide them with appropriate resources and guidance. Two, with these learnings, you will partner with our Sales Team to connect with other influential people in these organizations to identify new business opportunities that are the pipeline for our company’s revenue goals by partnering proactively with our Sales Team. And three, you will develop valuable, transferable skills to help you achieve your career goals. By fulfilling our three core missions, you will contribute importantly to Grafana Labs’ community and business goals.
   

  

 We understand that our commercial success is linked to our open source DNA and users’ success with our software. As such, we want team members who can effectively leverage this connection and help support the long-term health of our company.
   

  

 In this role, you will balance reactive and proactive work, responding to inbound inquiries as well as outreaching to target accounts. You will need to research and have a detective mindset in order to craft thoughtful, value-add messaging; and you’ll need to be confident driving business conversations on the phone. You will need to know how to use AI as a tool to constantly improve your productivity.
   

  

 This is a demanding and rewarding role. It is a fast-paced and challenging environment. While our company is growing sustainably, we still have a lot of building and improving to do. And we do this work together with our teammates from more than 15 different countries. We're looking for driven, humble, technically curious people who embrace a team-first attitude and demonstrate extreme ownership. This is a great team to join, whether you’re just starting your career or looking to pivot into the tech industry. You’ll have managers and teammates that care deeply about you as a professional and human, and you will learn more than you thought possible.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Build and maintain knowledge of our technology, competitors, open source ecosystem, and industry trends
* Follow up on inbound leads effectively and efficiently
* Use a multi-channel approach (email, social, calling) to proactively outreach to new leads within target accounts; our top SDRs are confident and effective on the phone
* Use Salesforce and Grafana dashboards for lead and account management and research
* Use research and data to prioritize and customize outreach to target prospects and accounts via email and LinkedIn
* Drive effective discovery conversations to understand users’ needs and goals in to provide them the appropriate resources and communicate how Grafana can help them
* Consistently meet new business opportunity and pipeline targets
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as marketing and sales to win as a team


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* Open to feedback and coaching, always looking for ways to improve
* Clear and concise written and verbal communication style
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to prioritize many tasks and demands
* Willingness and ability to take on any task - no matter how small or big - with a focus on quality
* Resourceful and proactive in an environment that is constantly evolving
* Driven by purpose and by winning with a team-first attitude
* Located in the Sweden


**Bonus Points For**
 Let’s be honest - interviewing is not easy. However, we want you to come prepared and succeed. When we interview, we’re trying to determine a couple of things:
   

  

* Would you be successful if you were part of our team?
* Will you love working here and be a positive influence on your fellow colleagues?
* Will you grow professionally and personally during your time here?
* We’re looking for people who are curious and passionate about technology, so make sure you invest some time in learning about Grafana Labs. Explore our community, the industry we operate in, what we offer, and how we set ourselves apart.
* During your interview, you’ll be sharing stories about your current and past roles and experiences. The best way to frame this is with the CARR model: Context, Action, Results, Reflection. This allows you to succinctly share the experiences you’ve gained.
* Remember, humility drives learning and we love working with people who are always trying to better themselves. Throughout our interview process, you will receive feedback, and usually directly in the interview. As you move through the interview process, make sure you listen to the feedback you receive and figure out how to incorporate the advice in the next step of the interview.


**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the OTE (On-Target Earnings) compensation range for this role is 530,00 SEK - 564,000 SEK. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Managementkonsulter inom offentlig sektor
description:
**Managementkonsulter inom offentlig sektor till Capgemini Invent** 




  





 Vi på Capgemini Invent tror på att olikheter driver förändring. Som transformationskonsulter förenar vi strategiska, kreativa och vetenskapliga kompetenser och samarbetar nära våra kunder för att leverera lösningar i framkant. Bli en del av oss och driv transformation anpassad efter våra kunders utmaningar. Med vetenskap och data som grund, kreativitet och design som drivkraft – och teknik skapad med syfte som möjliggörare.
 



  





**OM ROLLEN** 




 I denna roll kommer du få möjlighet att:
 


* Arbeta med några av Sveriges mest samhällsviktiga organisationer och bidra till strategiska förflyttningar som skapar långsiktig nytta för medborgare, samhälle och demokrati.
* Ta dig an komplexa utmaningar inom strategi, styrning, verksamhetsutveckling och transformation, i nära samarbete med kunder och beslutsfattare på ledningsnivå.
* Bli en del av ett engagerat och högpresterande team som kombinerar entreprenörskap, samarbete och kunskapsdelning. Hos oss får du stort eget ansvar, stöd från erfarna kollegor och goda möjligheter att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt.



  





**DIN PROFIL** 



* **Utbildning:** 
 Du har en masterexamen med goda akademiska resultat inom exempelvis ekonomi, statsvetenskap, samhällsvetenskap, nationalekonomi eller political science.
* **Erfarenhet:** 
 Du har nyligen tagit examen eller tar examen under 2027 och har 0-3 års arbetslivserfarenhet efter studierna.
* **Personliga egenskaper:** 
 Du är nyfiken, analytisk, ambitiös och har ett starkt driv att göra skillnad. Du har ett strakt samhällsintresse samt ett proaktivt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt med affärsmässigt tänk.
* **Meriterande:** 
 Erfarenhet från offentlig sektor, internationella erfarenheter, engagemang i studentaktiviteter eller ideella organisationer.
* **Språk:** 
 Du behärskar flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.



  





**DET BÄSTA MED ATT ARBETA HOS OSS** 




**Karriärsutveckling:** 
 Vi erbjuder en tydlig utvecklingsväg med stöd för att växa in i rollen som konsult – genom utbildningar, mentorskap och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling.
 



**Samarbetskultur:** 
 Du blir en del av ett stödjande team där kunskapsdelning och samarbete står i centrum. Vi arbetar med helhetslösningar som skapar verkligt värde för våra kunder.
 



**Inspirerande arbetsplats:** 
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att forma din egen framtid. Du blir en del av en social och välkomnande arbetsmiljö med många spännande aktiviteter och initiativ.
 



  





**BRA ATT VETA** 





 Startdatum och placering
 




 Som nyexaminerad kommer du att börja under hösten 2027. Möjlighet att resa förekommer i rollen samt arbete på våra kunders kontor. If you have already graduated, there may be an opportunity to start earlier, during Spring 2027.
 



  






 Ansökningsprocess
 




 Ansökningar behandlas löpande – skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt eftersom vi har begränsat antal platser. Bifoga ditt CV på svenska samt dina officiella student och universitetsbetyg (ladda upp under “Cover letter” i ansökningssystemet). Det finns endast ett fält för att ladda upp dina betyg, så vi ber dig vänligen att slå ihop dina gymnasie-, kandidat- och masterbetyg till ett enda dokument innan du laddar upp det. Ange tydligt ditt förväntade examensdatum. Ofullständiga ansökningar kommer inte att behandlas.
 



 Vänligen notera: Du kommer behöva uppvisa giltig ID-handling vid första intervjutillfället.
 



  






 Nästa steg i processen
 




 Urvalsprocessen består av flera steg för att säkerställa en rättvis och grundlig bedömning:
 


* Granskning av CV och betyg
* Telefonintervju
* Videointervju (som inkluderar ett case)
* Case på plats på vårt kontor
* Slutintervju
* Erbjudande



  





**OM CAPGEMINI** 




 Capgemini är en AI-driven global partner för affärs- och tekniktransformation som levererar konkret verksamhetsnytta. Vi formar framtiden för organisationer och förverkligar den med hjälp av AI, teknik och människor. Med vår starka historia på nästan 60 år är vi en ansvarsfull och mångsidig koncern med över 420 000 medarbetare i över 50 länder. Genom vår expertis inom strategi, teknik, design, ingenjörstjänster och affärsverksamhet levererar vi heltäckande tjänster och lösningar, baserade på vår djupa branschkunskap och vårt omfattande partnernätverk. Koncernen rapporterade globala intäkter på 22,5 miljarder euro för 2025.

title: Enhetschef till avdelningen för signalunderrättelser
description:

Är du den vi söker kan vi erbjuda ett varierande arbete i en kunskapsintensiv miljö där du får vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 Som enhetschef hör du till ett kontor inom avdelningen för signalunderrättelser och en enhet som verkar inom området rysk militär verksamhet. Avdelningen för signalunderrättelser arbetar med att bearbeta och analysera inhämtat material i syfte att rapportera unika och efterfrågade underrättelser till våra uppdragsgivare.
   

  

 I rollen leder du en grupp analytiker som har uppgiften att rapportera underrättelser i olika tidstempon till FRA:s uppdragsgivare. Du ansvarar för enhetens utgående underrättelseproduktion och har särskilt ansvar för att underrättelseproduktionen och arbetet vid enheten sker i enlighet med gällande inriktning, tillstånd och lagstiftning. Du tillser att enhetens medarbetare har rätt förutsättningar genom tillgång till verktyg, information och kompetensutveckling. Rollen innefattar personal-, budget- och arbetsmiljöansvar.
   

  

 Som enhetschef har du en viktig roll som tydlig kommunikatör och ansvarar för att utveckla arbetet på enheten. Verksamhetsansvaret koordinerar du med andra chefer och ledare på den berörda sektionen och kontoret. Du har många kontakter inom avdelningen och myndigheten, men också externa kontakter med myndighetens uppdragsgivare. Du ingår i sektionens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar till sektionschefen.

* Erfarenhet av en roll som ledare
* God datorvana
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

* Utbildning från försvarssektorn.
* Erfarenhet av en roll med personalansvar
* Erfarenhet från försvars- och/eller tekniksektorn
* Tidigare arbetat med underrättelseverksamhet
* Kompetens inom och/eller intresse för militära frågor
* Kunskap inom radio, telekom och/eller förståelse för teknik


 Du är
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Med Följande Egenskaper**
* Ledarskap - Du leder, motiverar och förser andra med befogenheter som krävs för att effektivt nå gemensamma mål. Samordnar grupper och blir en referenspunkt för andra. Skapar engagemang och delaktighet.
* Tydlig - Du kommunicerar på ett tydligt sätt. Säkerställer att budskap når fram och att förväntningarna är klara för alla berörda parter. Påminner och följer upp.
* Flexibel - Du har lätt för att anpassa sig till ändrade omständigheter. Kan snabbt ändra sitt synsätt och förhållningssätt. Ser möjligheterna i förändringar.
* Integritet - Du har väl grundade och tydliga värderingar och förmåga att tänka begreppsmässigt på frågor ur ett etiskt perspektiv. Styrs av etik och värderingar i avgörande situationer i arbetet.


 Om FRA
   

  

 FRA har omvärlden som sin arena där varje arbetsuppgift är en del av något större. På ett eller annat sätt får du som medarbetare vara med och bidra till att skydda Sveriges integritet och oberoende i världen. Du är med och gör skillnad på riktigt, varje dag.

Vi skyddar det viktigaste vi har – vår trygghet, vår demokrati och vårt sätt att leva. Vi är experter på cyberområdet och signalspaning samt en larmklocka för militära hot.

title: Head of Strategy and Transformation
description:
*Defence and security are changing fast. Demand is increasing and technology is reshaping what is possible. Saab – and Naval Combat Systems – are investing for growth and adapting to this shift.*
*To succeed, we need to be clearer in our direction, more deliberate in our choices and more consistent in how we execute. That is why we are establishing a dedicated Strategy & Transformation function – and we are now looking for a senior leader to build and lead it.*
 Your role
   

  

 As Head of Strategy & Transformation, you will make sure that our strategy is realised in how we prioritise, invest and work – not just in how we talk.
   

  

 You will have overall responsibility for the NCS strategic plan and mid‑ to long‑term roadmap, and for turning this into a focused transformation agenda across our Product Units and global roles. You will help us choose where to focus, what to build, how to organise and in which order to move.
   

  

 You will work closely with Product Units such as Fire Control System and Combat Systems, as well as Portfolio & Modularisation, Governance & Operations, global roles and Marketing & Sales. You report to the Head of Strategy, Portfolio & Governance.
   

  

 Together with the BU leadership and line organisation, you will for example:
   

  

* Shape and maintain NCS roadmaps for growth, capabilities and investments, based on market, customer and technology developments
* Bring together initiatives from our Product Units and global roles into a coherent portfolio with clear priorities and sequencing
* Support critical decisions on portfolio, industrial footprint, operating model and ways of working
* Establish a practical approach to follow‑up on progress, benefits and KPIs – and adjust when reality changes
* Help leaders and teams navigate change so that new structures and processes actually take hold


 At Naval Combat Systems, our ambition is to be the world’s most trusted integrator of software‑defined naval combat capabilities – enabling our customers to see, understand and act faster than a qualified adversary through continuously evolving combat systems. In Strategy & Transformation, you turn this ambition into clear direction and a coordinated transformation agenda for the business.
   

  

 You are offered a key role with significant strategic impact in an international, technology‑intensive business. You will work closely with senior decision‑makers across Saab and contribute directly to Saab’s long‑term development and competitiveness.
   

  

 Your profile
   

  

 You are a senior leader with solid experience from driving strategy and transformation in complex, technology‑intensive organisations. You are used to working with executive teams, and you bring both strategic perspective and a grounded understanding of how businesses really change.
   

  

 We believe you have:
   

  

* Documented experience from leading a business, product area or major transformation, with clear accountability for results
* Background from high‑tech, industrial or system‑driven environments with many stakeholders and interfaces
* Proven ability to develop and implement strategies, portfolios or roadmaps and to follow up on value and effects
* Strong analytical skills and sound judgement, with the ability to frame options and trade‑offs for senior decision‑makers
* Well‑developed communication skills, and the ability to create clarity and alignment across different parts of an organisation


 As a leader, you are pragmatic and steady. You listen, you build confidence, and you are prepared to challenge when needed. You are motivated by long‑term impact, not quick wins, and you take pride in helping others succeed around you.
   

  

*This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.*
 What you will be part of
   

  

 Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
   

  

 Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by its 30,000 talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
   

  

 Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here

title: Säkerhetsgeneralist Saab Naval
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
 Din roll
   

  

 Inom Saab är säkerhet högt prioriterat, finns på högsta ledningens agenda och är avgörande för konkurrenskraft, lönsamhet och förtroende på en utmanande global marknad. Saab Navals personalsäkerhetsteam söker nu en säkerhetsgeneralist med en tilltänkt bred arbetsportfölj. Arbetsuppgifterna utgår från personalsäkerhetsområdet men har ett riktat fokus på bland annat insider risk management, event- och resesäkerhet.
   

  

 Som säkerhetsgeneralist rapporterar du i första hand till chefen för personalsäkerhet vid Saab Naval samt i förekommande fall andra sidoordnande chefer eller projektledare.
   

  

 Du kommer att representera Saab Naval:s personalsäkerhetsteam i flertalet forum och arbeta nära övriga kollegor inom Saab Naval:s säkerhetsavdelning. Dessutom kommer du dagligen samarbeta med andra relevanta funktioner såsom HR, koncernfunktioner och produktionsverksamhet.
   

  

 Eftersom vi är ett multinationellt företag arbetar vi i en internationell kontext, vilket innebär både nationella och internationella resor.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor vid Solna strand och medger distansarbete i enlighet med SAAB:s övergripande policy. Du kommer samarbeta med medarbetare placerade på alla SAAB:s verksamhetsorter i Sverige men i synnerhet kollegor tjänstgörande i Karlskrona, Lund och Docksta.
   

  

 Din profil
   

  

 Vi söker dig som besitter tålamod och kan förhålla dig till längre processer över lång tid men också kan tempoväxla mot prioriterade och tidskritiska arbetsuppgifter. Du har ett genuint intresse för säkerhetsområdet och håller dig uppdaterad om förändringar i lagstiftning och krav inom ditt ansvarsområde. Personliga egenskaper kommer att vara av största vikt, där pålitlighet och en stark etisk kompass är avgörande för att lyckas i rollen.
   

  

 För att lyckas i denna roll behöver du även ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom personalsäkerhetsområdet eller med arbetsuppgifter nära besläktade med arbetsområdet. Vi ser gärna att du har formell utbildning inom säkerhetsarbete men värdesätter kvalitativ arbetsbetsliverfarenhet högt. Du har företrädelsevis arbetat i större organisationer, där du tidigare bidragit till både operationellt och strategiskt säkerhetsarbete.
   

  

 Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager | Early Career Program
description:
**About This Opportunity**
 Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.
   

  

 The accelerated track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across a range of functions such as Sales, Commercial Management, Sourcing, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value.
   

  

 This isn’t a program where you sit on the sideline. From day one, you’re hired permanently into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. Your journey within the
 **Early Career Program** 
 will start as a
 **Strategic Sourcing Manager**
**About The Team**
 We as the Sourcing Team, look after 130 billion SEK external spend working with suppliers all around the world. That means we influence around 62% of Ericsson’s net sales value by searching for the best and negotiating favorable deals. We are one big team of around 1,000 people in more than 60 countries working with more than 20,000 suppliers. Our job is very exciting because we get to work with an end-to-end business approach, gaining insight and understanding from R&D to Service Delivery.
   

  

 We are looking for potentially
 **six Strategic Sourcing Managers** 
 , depending on your assigned team, you may work with different sourcing categories
   

  

* Electrical Manufacturing Services: Sourcing global manufacturing services for Ericsson’s product portfolio, and related supply chain and industrialization services.
* Energy Systems: Sourcing energy site products, related SW features and energy related products for data centers and lab operation to ensure reliable and energy-efficient operation on site.
* IT Software: Sourcing software, cloud solutions, and IT services that support Ericsson's technology portfolio.
* Logistics & Freight: Sourcing transportation, freight and logistics services that enable the movement of products across Ericsson's global supply chain.
* Network Products Hardware: Sourcing hardware components, equipments and solutions used in Ericsson's radio and network products.
* Repair: Sourcing repair, refurbishment, and related lifecycle services that support Ericsson’s products and global supply chain.


 While each team has its own focus, they share the same goal: building strong supplier partnerships, driving commercial excellence, and supporting Ericsson's innovation and business performance.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a Strategic Sourcing Manager, you will work at the intersection of business, technology, and supplier collaboration. You will contribute to sourcing strategies, commercial decisions, and supplier partnerships that create value for Ericsson and its customers.
   

  

 While your responsibilities will depend on your assigned sourcing area, you will have the opportunity to:
   

  

* Contribute to sourcing projects, including RFx processes, supplier evaluation, selection, negotiation and onboarding.
* Build and manage supplier relationships to drive performance, quality, innovation, and long-term business value.
* Analyze supplier, market, and commercial data to support fact-based decisions, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation.
* Support responsible sourcing, sustainability, environmental, and compliance requirements
* Collaborate with cross-functional and regional stakeholders to align sourcing activities with business needs.
* Support digital vision initiatives and explore digital tools, dashboard, automation, and AI to improve sourcing processes efficiency, and decision-making.


**You will bring**
* A master’s degree in Supply chain management, Business, Economics, Information System, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
* Good communication and storytelling skills to collaborate and influence stakeholders.
* Curious, proactive, and results-oriented, with a passion for continuous learning.
* Confidence to speak up, challenge existing ways of working, and bring new ideas.
* Commercial awareness and an interest in creating business value.
* Interest in emerging technologies, analytics, automation, AI or supply chain management.
* Previous experience or academic exposure in procurement, contract management, finance, IT software, manufacturing, logistics, and Power BI or similar tools is a plus.


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?** 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.
   

  

**Primary country and city:** 
 Sweden (SE) ||

title: Student to Prime Collateral Services | SEB Stockholm
description:
Are you ready to dive into the dynamic world of banking and finance? SEB’s Prime Collateral Services (PCS) team offers a talented student an exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience and grow their potential on the side of their studies. If you have the ambition, we will support you every step of the way!
   

  

**About The Role**
 Prime Collateral Services (PCS) is part of Investor Services within Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB). We provide collateral management services to institutional and corporate clients, supporting their trading activities across derivatives, repo and securities lending.
   

  

 We are now looking for a
 **student with an interest in financial markets** 
 who wants to gain practical experience alongside their studies and become part of our team.
   

  

**What You Will Be Doing**
 As a Student Collateral Manager, you will work alongside experienced colleagues and gradually learn how collateral and client relationship management works in practice.
   

  

 You will be introduced to the daily processes behind derivatives and securities financing transactions and support the team in delivering our services to clients.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will gradually develop as you gain experience and may include:
   

  

* Supporting the daily collateral management process
* Monitoring exposures, collateral positions and ongoing transactions
* Assisting with margin calls, collateral movements and reconciliations
* Following up on settlements, exceptions and outstanding items
* Supporting communication with clients, counterparties and other internal and external stakeholders
* Working with financial data, reports and operational controls
* Contributing to improvements in our processes and ways of working
* Collaborating with colleagues across PCS and other parts of SEB


 The role gives you the opportunity to develop a practical understanding of
 **derivatives, repo, securities lending and post-trade processes** 
 , while gaining experience from a client-oriented environment within CIB.
   

  

 You will receive training and support from the team, with the ambition that you gradually take on more responsibility as your knowledge and experience develop.
   

  

**Who We Are Looking For**
 We believe you are a curious and ambitious student who wants to learn more about financial markets and how a large financial institution operates behind the scenes.
   

  

 You enjoy taking responsibility, learning new things and working together with others. Since collateral management involves both financial products and time-critical processes, you are also comfortable working in a structured and detail-oriented way.
   

  

 We believe that you:
   

  

* Are currently studying economics, finance, business, engineering or another relevant field with at least 2 years remaining until graduation.
* Have a genuine interest in financial markets
* Are analytical, structured and attentive to detail
* Are curious and eager to learn
* Take initiative and are comfortable asking questions
* Enjoy problem-solving and taking ownership of your tasks
* Are a collaborative team player who contributes to a positive working environment
* Communicate confidently in both Swedish and English


 Previous experience from banking or financial markets is an advantage, but
 **not a requirement** 
 . We are primarily looking for someone with the right attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn.
   

  

**Practical setup**
 The position is designed to work alongside your university studies. The typical setup is around
 **8 hours per week during semesters, with opportunities to work more during summer and Christmas holidays** 
 .
   

  

**Learn more about working at SEB** 
**www.sebgroup.com/career**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

**Welcome with your application**
 We look forward to receiving your application! Please make sure to include the following documents as
 **one combined file** 
 :
   

  

* Your CV (not a LinkedIn profile), with your GPA clearly stated
* Grade transcripts from university
* A 100-word paragraph outlining your motivation and interest (space dedicated for it in the application form)


 Please note that applications submitted without a CV will not be considered.
   

  

 Please also note that you do not need to upload a cover letter even though the application form might have an option for it.
   

  

 Submit your application as soon as possible, but
 **no later than 1st November 2026** 
 at 23:59 CET.
   

  

 If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact Niklas Hagberg at niklas.hagberg@seb.se
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks.

***Job Description***
---------------------

*Vill du kombinera djup teknisk kompetens med möjligheten att påverka framtidens utvecklingsmiljö för bankens Cobolutvecklare? Till Team Cobol Pipeline söker vi nu en tekniskt driven person som vill vara med och vidareutveckla vår moderna verktygskedja och samtidigt ta en ledande roll i teamets tekniska vägval.*

***Ditt team***
