title: Key Account Director - Nordics
description:
#### **Join Telavox as a Key Account Director for the Nordics**

Are you a commercially driven relationship builder who enjoys growing strategic partnerships and turning opportunities into long-term business results? At Telavox, we work closely with operators and service providers to help them grow their B2B business through innovative communication solutions.


Telavox is a fast-growing digital telco that combines the reliability of telecom with the agility of SaaS. Our UCaaS platform enables operators and service providers across Europe and the Middle East to offer businesses smarter communication solutions, bringing together fixed and mobile telephony, phone systems, AI, integrations, analytics, collaboration, and omnichannel features.


Our service provider customers include Mobile Network Operators (MNOs) and Cloud PBX and VoIP carriers that distribute our platform as part of their own product portfolios.


We are now looking for a Key Account Director to take ownership of one of our largest and most strategic operator partnerships in the Nordics. This is an opportunity to shape a key relationship, drive upsell and revenue growth, and play an important part in our ambition to build a global software company serving operators.

#### **About the job**


As our Key Account Director, Nordics, you own and develop one of our most important operator relationships. Your main mission is to grow the partnership by identifying new business opportunities, strengthening relationships across the customer's organisation, and turning shared ambitions into measurable results.


You are the primary point of contact and trusted advisor to the operator, building relationships from operational teams to executive management. You understand their business, priorities, and challenges, and use that insight to identify opportunities for expansion, increased adoption, and revenue growth. This includes helping the operator acquire more end customers, expand its service offering, and generate more revenue through our platform.


This is a senior, commercially focused role where you lead through influence rather than formal authority. The role has no direct reports, so success depends on your ability to bring together the right people across Telavox and the operator, aligning commercial ambitions with product capabilities and operational delivery to make the partnership successful.


You will report to the Head of Business Unit Telavox Platform and work closely with teams across Product, Engineering, and Customer Service Delivery.

**Your day-to-day work includes:**

* Own and develop the overall relationship with the operator, acting as their main point of contact and trusted advisor across all levels of the organisation
* Build and execute a strategic account plan with clear goals for revenue growth, customer adoption, customer satisfaction, and long-term partnership development
* Identify and drive upsell and expansion opportunities through new services, customer segments, and use cases
* Lead commercial discussions, negotiations, renewals, and contract expansions, ensuring value for both parties
* Build business cases and use commercial insights and data to identify opportunities and support decisions that drive growth
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Service Delivery, as well as teams within the operator, to align priorities and deliver a strong customer offering
* Work with the operator on joint go-to-market initiatives to grow their B2B business and increase adoption of our platform
* Monitor account performance, forecast revenue accurately, and proactively manage risks, challenges, and escalations
* Represent Telavox at industry events and continue building strong relationships across the Nordic operator ecosystem


The role is remote or hybrid, based within the Nordics.

#### **About you**


You are a commercially minded relationship builder with deep expertise in telecom software solutions and several years of experience developing strategic partnerships and growing complex B2B accounts. You understand that successful account management goes beyond maintaining relationships; it requires commercial curiosity, a clear strategy, and the ability to turn customer needs into business opportunities.


You are comfortable navigating complex organisations, engaging with senior stakeholders, and bringing different teams together around shared goals. You combine a long-term perspective with a strong drive to create results, and you know how to balance customer value with commercial growth.


You are structured, trustworthy, and proactive. You build credibility through your understanding of the customer's business, follow through on commitments, and know how to influence people without having direct authority over them.

**We are looking for someone with:**

* Several years of experience in strategic account management or senior B2B sales, ideally within telecom software, with operators, or in a service provider environment
* A proven track record of owning and growing large, complex customer relationships, including strategic account planning, stakeholder mapping, and executive engagement
* A strong understanding of the Nordic telecom landscape, including key players and business models, ideally combined with an established network within the operator ecosystem
* In-depth knowledge of VoIP, SIP trunking, UCaaS, and MNO or service provider business models
* Experience identifying commercial opportunities, developing business cases, and negotiating complex contracts, renewals, and expansions
* Strong solution-selling skills and the ability to understand technical solutions and translate them into clear customer value and business outcomes
* The ability to use data and commercial insights to support decision-making, identify opportunities, and drive account growth
* Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage with decision-makers at all levels
* A collaborative and influential way of working, bringing together teams across different functions and organisations to achieve shared results
* A bachelor's degree in Business, Telecommunications, or a related field. An MBA is a plus
* Fluent English, written and spoken. A Nordic language such as Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is a strong plus

#### **Join us at Telavox**


Since Telavox's journey started in 2002, we have strengthened our position as the leading forward-thinking communication platform for businesses. As a digital mobile operator, we develop and own our all-in-one communication platform, which integrates telephony, PBX, messaging, meetings, and contact centers, giving businesses a smarter way to connect.  

  

Today, we’re a thriving company with 1.9 billion SEK in revenue and 500+ Telavoxers across nine countries. We embrace AI and automation to push the boundaries of business communication.  

  

We offer flexible work options and adaptable hours, giving you the freedom to balance life and career while staying connected to our vibrant Telavox culture.


Read more about our new HQ in Malmö !

### **How to apply!**


At Telavox, we don’t focus on fitting in. We focus on making room for everyone, regardless of background, experience, or who you are.


We’re always looking for great talent, and we review applications on an ongoing basis. If you’re excited about joining an innovative, AI-driven telecom company, we’d love to hear from you! Apply with your CV and cover letter in English.


Please note that, in accordance with GDPR, we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.


Looking forward to your application!

**Learn more about what we do ️**

title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.



We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.



You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

  


This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Sweden.


**About Product Management**
----------------------------



As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.



Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.


**The role**
------------



As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes **Grafana Federal Cloud**, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes **Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC)**, which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.



Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.



Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.



As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:


* Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
* Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
* Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
* Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
* Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

**We’re excited about you because you have**
--------------------------------------------


* 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, *or* a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
* Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
* Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
* Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
* Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
* Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

### **Bonus Points**


* Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
* Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
* Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
* Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
* Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
* Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies


*In Sweden, the base compensation range for this role is SEK 996,819* *- SEK 1,196,182**. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.*


* *Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.*


**Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:**


* **100% Remote, Global Culture -** As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* **Scaling Organization** – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* **Transparent Communication** – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* **Innovation-Driven** – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* **Open Source Roots** – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* **Empowered Teams** – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* **Career Growth Pathways** – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* **Approachable Leadership** – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* **Passionate People** – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* **In-Person onboarding** - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* **Balance is Key** - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *\*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.*


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** *Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*


*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*



#LI-Remote



*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our* *privacy policy**.*

title: Strategic Sourcing Manager | Early Career Program
description:
**About this opportunity**
--------------------------



Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward.

  

The accelerated track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across a range of functions such as Sales, Commercial Management, Sourcing, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value.

  

This isn’t a program where you sit on the sideline. From day one, you’re hired permanently into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here. Your journey within the **Early Career Program** will start as a **Strategic Sourcing Manager**

**About the team**
------------------



We as the Sourcing Team, look after 130 billion SEK external spend working with suppliers all around the world. That means we influence around 62% of Ericsson’s net sales value by searching for the best and negotiating favorable deals. We are one big team of around 1,000 people in more than 60 countries working with more than 20,000 suppliers. Our job is very exciting because we get to work with an end-to-end business approach, gaining insight and understanding from R&D to Service Delivery.

  

We are looking for potentially **six Strategic Sourcing Managers**, depending on your assigned team, you may work with different sourcing categories

* **Electrical Manufacturing Services:** Sourcing global manufacturing services for Ericsson’s product portfolio, and related supply chain and industrialization services.
* **Energy Systems:** Sourcing energy site products, related SW features and energy related products for data centers and lab operation to ensure reliable and energy-efficient operation on site.
* **IT Software:** Sourcing software, cloud solutions, and IT services that support Ericsson's technology portfolio.
* **Logistics & Freight:** Sourcing transportation, freight and logistics services that enable the movement of products across Ericsson's global supply chain.
* **Network Products Hardware:** Sourcing hardware components, equipments and solutions used in Ericsson's radio and network products.
* **Repair:** Sourcing repair, refurbishment, and related lifecycle services that support Ericsson’s products and global supply chain.


While each team has its own focus, they share the same goal: building strong supplier partnerships, driving commercial excellence, and supporting Ericsson's innovation and business performance.

**What you will do**
--------------------



As a Strategic Sourcing Manager, you will work at the intersection of business, technology, and supplier collaboration. You will contribute to sourcing strategies, commercial decisions, and supplier partnerships that create value for Ericsson and its customers.

  

While your responsibilities will depend on your assigned sourcing area, you will have the opportunity to:

* Contribute to sourcing projects, including RFx processes, supplier evaluation, selection, negotiation and onboarding.
* Build and manage supplier relationships to drive performance, quality, innovation, and long-term business value.
* Analyze supplier, market, and commercial data to support fact-based decisions, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to millions of people in their everyday lives.


Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.


In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.


By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.


Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.


As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.


If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.

##### **About the role**


As Senior Platform Engineer, you will design, develop, and continuously improve secure, scalable, and reliable cloud-native platforms based on Microsoft Azure and Azure Kubernetes Service. The role combines hands-on engineering with platform architecture and technical leadership, providing standardised infrastructure, Kubernetes services, deployment capabilities, and self-service solutions that enable development teams to deliver applications efficiently.


You will ensure that cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes environments are automated, repeatable, observable, and governed according to security and operational best practices, and establish the technical standards, reusable patterns, and documentation required to support consistent platform adoption across the organisation.


Your responsibilities will include:

* Defining platform strategies, technical roadmaps, and architectural standards, and translating business, application, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform capabilities.
* Providing technical leadership throughout the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of shared platforms, including technical design reviews of changes to shared platforms and security boundaries.
* Designing and managing Azure infrastructure, from AKS clusters, networking, and container registries to identity, secrets, backup, and PostgreSQL services, using infrastructure as code and automated pipelines.
* Designing and operating GitOps-based delivery models and establishing Kubernetes platform services.
* Designing secure authentication and authorisation models, implementing Kubernetes governance and admission-control policies, and maintaining least-privilege isolation between applications, teams, workloads, and platform services.
* Supporting software supply-chain security through image signing, verification, controlled deployment pipelines, and repository controls.
* Designing self-service onboarding and provisioning capabilities, with platform automation that is idempotent, repeatable, and supported by validation, dry-run, or what-if capabilities.
* Developing observability solutions and defining platform-health monitoring, alerting, capacity-management, autoscaling, reliability, and incident follow-up practices.
* Creating proofs of concept and evaluating new technologies to validate architectural decisions, reduce implementation risk, and develop platform-engineering standards and best practices.
* Collaborating with application development, DevOps, security, infrastructure, architecture, and observability stakeholders, and supporting application teams with platform integration, migration, deployment patterns, and troubleshooting.
* Maintaining technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration standards, implementation guides, operator handbooks, and user documentation.

**Who you are**

* **Analytical and architectural:** Brings excellent analytical, architectural, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to gather and evaluate requirements and conduct proofs of concept.
* **Technical leader:** Able to lead technical initiatives and balance developer experience with security, reliability, governance, and operational requirements.
* **Strong communicator:** Communicates complex designs clearly, with excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.

**Key qualifications and experience**


Strong practical experience across the following areas:

* **Cloud and Azure:** Azure, Azure Kubernetes Service, Entra ID, managed identities, Key Vault, Azure Container Registry, Private Link, Azure Backup, PostgreSQL Flexible Server, and Azure DevOps.
* **Infrastructure as code, automation, and development:** Bicep, Terraform, Bash, Go, TypeScript, YAML, HCL, GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, OIDC federation, and GitHub Apps.
* **Kubernetes and GitOps:** Kubernetes, ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize, Gateway API, Envoy Gateway, cert-manager, external-dns, External Secrets Operator, Azure Service Operator, Kyverno, Karpenter, Cilium, Calico, Istio, and custom horizontal pod autoscaling.
* **Observability and reliability:** Grafana, Grafana Cloud, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Alloy, kube-state-metrics, Prometheus, Thanos, Alertmanager, and Kibana.
* **Security and governance:** Workload identity, federated credentials, RBAC, custom roles, admission control, multi-tenant security, policy enforcement, image signing and verification, CODEOWNERS, repository rulesets, and the Notary Project.
* **Delivery and service management:** Requirements gathering, technical roadmaps, platform documentation, Jira Service Desk, and the Atlassian suite.

**Excited?**


Get in touch! We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, please feel free to contact Henrietta, henrietta.dalman@odevo.com, Talent Lead at Odevo.

title: Technical Project Lead – Finance & Risk Data Transformation | Stockholm, SEB
description:
Are you an experienced Technical Project Lead with a strong background in data platforms, data warehousing, and data engineering? Join us in driving complex data migration and modernization initiatives, including the transition from legacy and mainframe environments to modern cloud-based data platforms as part of the broader CDS transformation, including FR360 and BIW.



SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. Cloud, AI, automation and modern engineering are natural parts of how we build, operate and continuously improve our technology platforms. From core banking platforms to hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, platform engineering, AI-enabled operations and automation, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future-proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

  


### **About the role**



As Technical Project Lead, you will play a central role in coordinating and driving strategic data transformation initiatives within SEB’s Finance and Risk area.



You will lead complex technical projects related to data migration, platform modernization, and the transition from legacy and mainframe-based solutions to modern cloud-based data platforms. The role includes supporting the broader CDS transformation, including the continued development of FR360 and the transformation of BIW.



FR360 is SEB’s Finance & Risk Data Platform. The platform is being developed into a modern, scalable, and audit-ready enterprise data warehouse that supports the reliable integration of more than 200 source systems. It provides trusted, traceable, and historically consistent data for Finance and Risk use cases in a regulated banking environment.



You will work closely with data engineers, architects, technical specialists, product owners, business stakeholders, and teams across Finance, Risk, and Group Technology. Your responsibility will be to create structure and transparency across technical deliveries, coordinate dependencies, manage risks, and ensure that transformation initiatives move from planning to successful implementation.



This is a hands-on leadership role. While you will not necessarily develop the technical solutions yourself, you need sufficient technical depth to understand data architectures, migration approaches, integration patterns, and engineering challenges. You should be comfortable facilitating technical decisions, challenging assumptions, and translating complex technical matters into clear plans and decision material for stakeholders and management.

  


### **Key responsibilities**



* Lead complex technical initiatives within data migration, data warehousing, and platform modernization.
* Drive the transition from legacy and mainframe-based environments to modern cloud-based data platforms.
* Coordinate deliveries connected to the broader CDS transformation, including FR360 and BIW.
* Establish clear project scope, objectives, milestones, delivery plans, and governance.
* Coordinate technical dependencies across platforms, systems, development teams, and business areas.
* Work closely with architects and engineers to understand migration strategies, target architectures, technical constraints, and implementation risks.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements, technical solutions, regulatory expectations, and delivery plans.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks, delivery risks, dependencies, and impediments.
* Facilitate technical workshops, planning sessions, architecture discussions, and decision-making forums.
* Prepare clear status reports, decision material, roadmaps, and management communication.
* Coordinate stakeholders across Finance, Risk, Group Technology, and involved source and consuming systems.
* Support the planning and execution of data migrations, testing, cutover, operational readiness, and decommissioning of legacy solutions.
* Promote structured ways of working, transparency, collaboration, and accountability across participating teams.
* Ensure that documentation, traceability, governance, and audit requirements are considered throughout the transformation.
  


### **To thrive in this role, we believe you have**



* Several years of experience leading complex technical projects or transformation initiatives.
* A strong background in data platforms, data warehousing, data integration, or data engineering.
* Experience with data migration and modernization of legacy or mainframe-based environments.
* A solid understanding of modern data architecture, data pipelines, data modelling, and cloud-based data platforms.
* Experience coordinating deliveries across several systems, teams, and organizational areas.
* The ability to understand technical challenges and translate them into concrete plans, priorities, risks, and decisions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, business representatives, and senior management.
* Experience identifying and managing complex technical dependencies and delivery risks.
* A structured and pragmatic approach, with the ability to create clarity in large and technically complex initiatives.
* Strong facilitation, planning, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience using AI-powered tools to improve engineering, operations or automation workflows, either professionally or through personal projects.


* Professional proficiency in English.

  


### **It is beneficial if you also have**



* Experience from banking, finance, or another regulated industry.
* Experience with Finance and Risk data, regulatory reporting, or large-scale enterprise data platforms.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform, including services such as BigQuery, Cloud Composer/Airflow, and Dataform/DBT.
* Knowledge of enterprise data warehouse concepts, Data Vault 2.0, data lineage, historization, metadata, and data quality.
* Experience working with batch-based or mainframe data flows and their migration to cloud-native solutions.
* Experience with system decommissioning, cutover planning, and operational transition.
* Knowledge of regulatory and governance requirements within data management, such as BCBS 239.
* Experience working in agile delivery environments and coordinating several agile teams.
* Familiarity with tools such as Jira and Confluence.

  


### **Personal qualities**



* We are looking for someone who combines technical understanding with strong leadership and communication skills.
* You are comfortable taking ownership and moving complex initiatives forward, even when all details are not yet known. You create structure, bring the right people together, and make dependencies and decisions visible. You are collaborative and pragmatic, but you are also prepared to challenge unclear requirements, unrealistic plans, and unresolved technical risks.
* You can move confidently between technical discussions and management communication, adapting the level of detail to the audience while maintaining focus on the overall objective.

  


### **What we offer**



* Agile and modern ways of working.
* A flat hierarchy and an open environment where ideas, opinions, and different points of view are welcomed.
* Extensive training and learning opportunities.
* The opportunity to work at an innovative company at the forefront of technology.
* The opportunity to contribute to a major transformation of SEB’s Finance and Risk data landscape.
* A hybrid working model, with the possibility of working remotely up to two days per week.

  


### **Do you want to be part of SEB?**



We believe that inclusion and diversity are crucial to our future success. We strive to foster an inclusive, value-driven culture in which employees feel valued, respected, and involved, regardless of who they are, what they believe, or where they come from.



We review applications continuously, so please submit your application through the link in this advertisement as soon as possible, and no later than **15/11-2026**. If you have questions about the position, please contact Thanh Truong at thanh.truong@seb.se. Please note that applications submitted by email will not be considered.



Please be aware that final candidates undergo background checks. These may include identity verification, verification of qualifications, credit checks, checks of company engagements, and criminal record checks. In some cases, random drug testing may also apply. During employment, SEB employees may be subject to recurring background checks.



SEB Sweden has a redeployment obligation, which means that this position may be subject to internal redeployment.



This employment is covered by collective agreements between Finansarbetsgivarna and Akademikerföreningen, and between Finansarbetsgivarna and Finansförbundet.



Learn more about working at SEB



* SEB careers website: https://sebgroup.com/career
* SEB career podcasts: https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

title: Thesis work – Context Engineering for AI Agents in Enterprise Analytics
description:
As a thesis student with us, you’ll have the opportunity to put your theoretical knowledge into practice while gaining unique insight into our operations. You’ll become part of our team, contribute to our development, and acquire valuable experience that strengthens both your skills and your CV. We look forward to hearing your ideas and supporting your growth!


Ort: Gällivare, Kiruna, Luleå
Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning
Ansök senast: 2026-11-30  


**The sustainable transformation begins with us**
-------------------------------------------------

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.


Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?


**Background of the assignment**
--------------------------------

The Analytics team at LKAB develops and maintains the company’s analytics products, delivered as a portfolio of apps on the team’s data platform. AI agents that build semantic models, reports and dashboards through MCP servers and command-line interfaces (CLIs) have quickly become practical tools in analytics development, both across the industry and in the team’s own work.


The question is no longer whether agents are capable of building analytics products, but what they need to know to build them correctly: how key metrics are defined, which conventions and business rules to apply, and where the same term can mean different things in different parts of the business. Both research and industry experience suggest that it is this context, rather than the capability of the AI model itself, that is the main bottleneck. Yet there is little evidence, based on real data from large industrial companies like LKAB, on how context should be leveraged to create the most value from agentic development.


To address this, the Analytics team wants to build a context layer for its data platform: a structured, version-controlled collection of metric definitions, business rules, ontologies, conventions and verified examples that AI agents can draw on while they work. This thesis will design and build that context layer, and evaluate how much each part of it contributes to the quality of the agents’ work.


**Problem statement**
---------------------

The thesis addresses three research questions:


1. How much does context (such as metric definitions, business rules, ontologies, conventions and verified examples) improve the quality of agentic development, and what is the value of each new context block relative to the effort needed to produce it?2. To what extent can a robust context layer narrow the gap between less and more capable AI models?3. In a pull request-based workflow, what share of the agent’s errors is caught by automated quality gates, and what share only by human review?


To answer these, you will build an agent environment where AI agents work against the team’s BI platform and data warehouse through MCP servers and CLIs, with automated quality gates. You will also build an evaluation suite of real development tasks, drawn from both well-defined and ambiguous parts of the business, with existing validated reports as ground truth. The evaluation is set up as a controlled experiment that adds context incrementally, removes individual context types (ablation), compares a less and a more capable AI model, and repeats each run several times. The suite is designed to be re-run as AI models evolve, so that the findings stay relevant over time.


The context layer, agent environment and evaluation suite are meant to be implemented in the real workflow of the development team, and stay in use by the team after the thesis is completed.


**What you bring**
------------------

You are currently enrolled in a Master of Science in Engineering or a master’s program in computer science, computer engineering, data science, engineering physics, or a related field, with a focus on software development, data, or AI.


You have strong programming skills, are comfortable with Python and Git and have a working knowledge of SQL and data modeling. You have experience with, or a strong interest in, agentic development methodologies, AI agents, large language models and how to evaluate them. Experience with BI tools, cloud tools, data warehouses and modern data platforms is a plus but not a requirement.


You are self-motivated and curious, enjoy building things that work in the real world, and are comfortable designing and running your own experiments. You will work closely with the Analytics team and gain first-hand insight into how LKAB uses data and AI in practice.


**Compensation for thesis projects and practical benefits at LKAB**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

For a thesis project approved by both the university and LKAB, we offer the following compensation:


* **35 000 SEK** for a thesis equivalent to **30 ECTS credits**.

title: Senior Platform Engineer – Azure APIM & Backstage
description:
**Swedium Global** is the growing System Engineering and Solution Company, offers services like Semiconductor Engineering R&D Services, Embedded Systems Development, Custom Application Software Development, Web and Cloud Application Development, Testing Services, Consultancy and Outsourcing services to our clients across the globe for an onsite and offshore business model. Swedium Global is having presence in Sweden, Finland, Poland, Czech Republic and in India.Senior Platform Engineer – Azure APIM & Backstage

**Description**  
You will play a central role in the continued development of an Integration Hub based on Azure API Management (APIM) and Backstage, with the goal of evolving the platform into a modern internal developer platform.

This assignment is ideal for someone with strong technical expertise in API management, developer portals, cloud infrastructure, and automation, who enjoys combining hands-on development with technical ownership.

**About the Assignment**  
As a Platform Engineer, you will play an important role in making APIs easier for developers across the organization to discover, understand, and consume.

**Azure API Management**  
Configure and maintain Azure API Management.  
Manage API onboarding, backend integrations, routing, and gateway policies.  
Implement authentication, authorization, and traffic management.  
Establish practices for monitoring, observability, and troubleshooting of API traffic and platform health.  
**Developer Portal & API Catalog**  
Develop and customize Backstage as the primary entry point for the Integration Hub.  
Improve usability, navigation, and branding of the developer portal.  
Manage API documentation, ownership information, and catalog metadata.  
Integrate APIs into the existing catalog and ensure consistency across systems.  
Develop or extend Backstage plugins and integrations where needed.  
**API Quality & Automation**  
Implement automated validation and linting of API specifications.  
Define and enforce API quality standards and documentation requirements.  
Integrate validation controls into CI/CD pipelines.  
Automate deployment and configuration management using Infrastructure-as-Code.  
**Platform Ownership**  
Produce technical documentation and onboarding materials.  
Troubleshoot issues across gateway, portal, catalog, application, and cloud infrastructure layers.  
Gather developer feedback and drive continuous improvements to the platform.  
Contribute to technical decision-making and platform roadmap activities.

**We Are Looking for Someone Who Has:**  
Strong hands-on experience with Azure API Management or an equivalent API management platform.  
Experience developing or extending Backstage or a similar Internal Developer Portal.  
Solid understanding of REST APIs, OpenAPI specifications, and API lifecycle management.  
Strong development skills in TypeScript/JavaScript, including Node.js and React.  
Experience with API security concepts, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT.  
Experience with Git-based development, CI/CD pipelines, and automation.  
Experience with or good knowledge of Terraform, Bicep, or similar Infrastructure-as-Code tools.  
Ability to troubleshoot across application, integration, infrastructure, and cloud environments.  
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.  
Ability to work independently and take technical ownership within the area.

**Nice to Have**  
Experience developing Backstage plugins and integrations with API catalogs.  
Experience with API linting tools such as Spectral.  
Experience with Azure Identity, Networking, and Observability services.  
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.  
Experience with Internal Developer Platforms and self-service architecture.

Job Type: Full-time

Work Location: In person

title: Experienced Business Analyst
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of insurance technology and driven by curiosity and eager to translate business and customer needs into clear actions?


At If, we are in the middle of a major business and technology transformation. As we modernize our core insurance platforms through Guidewire InsuranceSuite, we are building capabilities that will influence how we serve our customers and develop our business for years to come.
  

We are now looking for a experienced business analyst to join our growing Business Development and Transformation team. Whether your experience comes from insurance, financial services or another complex business domain, this is an opportunity to contribute to a large-scale Nordic transformation and help build long-term business and platform capabilities across If.

  

**About the role**
------------------

As a Business Analyst, you will work at the intersection of business and technology. You will help ensure that business needs are translated into sustainable solutions aligned with Guidewire Cloud principles and If's long-term direction.


You will work with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, development teams and business stakeholders to define, refine and prioritize epics and features that create business value.
  

By combining business understanding with platform knowledge and solution thinking, you will help us use the platform in a scalable and efficient way.


You will translate business needs into clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria, and support teams throughout the development lifecycle.


An important part of the role is to challenge requirements that create unnecessary complexity and guide stakeholders toward solutions based on standard capabilities and SaaS best practices. You will help If adapt processes and ways of working to a modern cloud platform, rather than over-customizing the platform to preserve existing ways of working.


You will not join a ready-made setup. You will help define how If uses Guidewire Cloud across our Nordic business, influence future solutions and ways of working, and contribute to long-term capability building. The role also gives you the opportunity to deepen your Guidewire expertise while collaborating with experienced colleagues across business and technology.


This role combines business understanding, analysis and solution delivery in an agile environment. You will help shape business initiatives from early analysis and epic definition through feature refinement, delivery and validation, ensuring that solutions are scalable, sustainable and aligned with business goals.


Guidewire certifications and previous platform experience are considered a strong advantage. However, for candidates with the right business and analytical capabilities, we offer the opportunity and expect a commitment to developing Guidewire expertise, including relevant certifications, as part of the role.

  

**What you will contribute to:**
--------------------------------

* Driving business analysis and requirement work from idea to implementation
* Shaping business initiatives through epic, feature and user story refinement
* Facilitating workshops and aligning stakeholders across business and technology
* Supporting backlog prioritization and value-driven decision making
* Defining acceptance criteria and contributing to testing and validation activities
* Conducting impact analysis and helping identify dependencies across teams, processes and systems
* Contributing to continuous improvement of business processes and platform capabilities
  

**We offer**
------------

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:


* An including work environment where everyone is welcome
* Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
* Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
* Possibility of hybrid workplace
* Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
* Great insurance benefits
  

  

**About the team**
------------------

You will join our growing Business Development and Transformation team, a Nordic competence community focused on shaping the future of If’s core business capabilities.


Together, we help translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting one of the largest business and technology transformations at If. We work across business domains, countries and delivery teams, combining business understanding, analysis and platform expertise to drive both current transformation initiatives and future business development.


Most of your day-to-day work will take place in agile and cross-functional teams, collaborating closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, Developers and business stakeholders.


At the same time, you will be part of a broader community where knowledge sharing, capability building and continuous learning are at the heart of how we work. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced colleagues from different business domains, exchange perspectives and best practices, and continuously develop both your business analysis and platform expertise.


Our ambition is to build business professionals with strong platform understanding who can bridge business and technology, drive meaningful change and contribute to long-term value creation across If.

  

**Who are You?**
----------------

You are a structured and analytical professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments. You combine business understanding with strong system insight and can move between the bigger picture and the details when needed.


You have a strong attention to detail and the ability to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements. You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, helping create a shared understanding and alignment across business and delivery teams.


You take ownership of your area, collaborate well across organizational boundaries, and are confident in challenging assumptions constructively while guiding stakeholders toward pragmatic and sustainable solutions.

  

**You also have:**
------------------

* Experience working with Guidewire InsuranceSuite is highly valued.
* Experience from other business-critical platforms, enterprise systems or complex transformation environments is also highly relevant.
* Experience as a Business Analyst, Business Developer, Product Owner or in a similar role
* Understanding of Cloud and SaaS-based delivery principles
* Proven ability to create clear epics, features, user stories and acceptance criteria
* Experience working in agile delivery models and supporting backlog refinement
* Ability to translate between business needs and system solutions
* Fluency in English; a Nordic language is considered an advantage
* Guidewire certifications and experience from transformation programs are considered strong advantages
  

**Additional facts and the recruitment process**
------------------------------------------------

**Application deadline:** Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, application deadline is **November 9th 2026** .


**To apply for the position:** Please attach your CV and answer the questions in the questionnaire


**Work location:** Any main office of If, Sweden or Finland


**Travelling:** Occasional travel is required


**Start:** As soon as possible / By agreement

  

For more information, please contact Sandra Jernberg, sandra.jernberg@if.se

  

*Background checks will be conducted in accordance with the law in the country of employment.*

  

We look forward to your application!

title: Network Automation Engineer
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

 **About the Opportunity**

  

Ericsson develops software-driven network solutions using Agile ways of working, Lean principles, Continuous Integration and modern automation. Customer and stakeholder feedback helps shape how our software, services and network capabilities evolve.

  

Join a cross-functional team supporting Ericsson’s global test labs. The team is developing a new network blueprint spanning purpose-built and cloud solutions, helping testers access secure remote test capabilities.  

AI-assisted development and large language models are part of our approach to productivity, software quality, innovation and continuous learning. You’ll work with experienced engineers and architects, who can help you build network-domain knowledge as you contribute.

 **What you will do**

* Maintain and improve the existing zero-touch provisioning framework as technologies and features evolve.
* Automate secure network deployment across test labs, including site-specific switch properties and security settings.
* Configure end-to-end test capabilities so testers can access the appropriate payloads, configurations and security.
* Develop, test and maintain automation solutions, integrations and validation processes; troubleshoot issues and improve reliability.
* Work with engineers, architects and stakeholders to turn requirements into practical, maintainable solutions.
* Use AI-assisted development and LLM tools for analysis, coding, testing, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge sharing; check their outputs for quality and accuracy.
* Contribute to continuous improvement, refactoring and innovation across the team.
 **Skills you bring**

* A completed degree in computer science, software engineering, electronics or a related field.
* Foundational development skills in Python, Go, C++ or a similar language, along with an understanding of software-development principles, secure development and revision control.
* Experience with Git or GitLab is valuable; familiarity with Continuous Integration and automated testing is an advantage.
* Curiosity, adaptability and a collaborative approach to solving technical challenges.
* Interest in networking, automation and applying new technologies. Deep telecom-network expertise is not required.
* Relevant experience is valued; around one to two years is a useful guide, not a strict requirement. Hands-on projects that demonstrate delivery are also valuable.
  

Experience or knowledge in one or more of these areas is a plus: GitLab Runner, Jenkins/Groovy, Linux, containers, TCP/IP, network-management systems, infrastructure-automation frameworks such as Nautobot, and cloud-native development.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
   

  

**The Role:**
 We are looking for a curious, smart, and “learn it all” Architect with proven experience and a passion for designing transformative solution architectures for our prospects and customers. This high-impact role demands a unique blend of deep technical expertise and executive presence, requiring you to confidently present to
 **C-level executives** 
 and translate their strategic goals into actionable technical plans. You will work with technical teams at our prospects and customers to design architectures that drive
 **enterprise modernization** 
 , leveraging techniques like
 **capability mapping** 
 and exploring innovative solutions with
 **Agentic AI** 
 .
   

  

 Your primary goal is to support our growing sales team in achieving revenue goals by unlocking technical blockers and partnering closely with our Sales, Value Engineering, Product Management, Data Ops, and Information Security teams. You will be responsible for supporting engagements with new prospects as well as existing customers that look to expand their footprint. Measures of success include new customer acquisition rates, retention, up-selling, and contribution to overall sales team and business success.
   

  

**The work you’ll do:**
* Lead and define the overall architecture, data, and cloud strategy for our largest client accounts, leveraging expertise like enterprise modernization and capability mapping.
* Confidently engage with and present to customer C-level executives, aligning their strategic objectives with the Celonis technical strategy.
* Drive innovation by identifying and architecting solutions that leverage emergent technologies, including Agentic AI.
* Be the bridge between our product & engineering teams within Celonis and the client's teams to provide the best technical services.
* Assess the IT landscape maturity of our customer installed base for the region.
* Participate in pre-Sales and post-Sales phases by engaging with customer Architecture and security teams.
* Coach and guide Celonis consulting teams and ecosystem partners on technical implementation issues such as architecture, integration, performance, and scalability.
* Develop re-usable assets for the consulting teams on projects.
* Develop customer-facing position papers, assets, and thought leadership presentations on architecture and innovation with Celonis.
* Create technical designs and presentations for internal and client stakeholders.


**The qualifications you need:**
* 10 to 15 years of relevant experience (e.g., Software vendor Architect, CTO at a top consulting firm, or Enterprise Architect at a customer).
* Proven ability to think strategically, connecting technical solutions to business value and customer objectives.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven track record of presenting complex technical concepts and strategic visions to C-level executives.
* Demonstrated experience in Capability Mapping, Enterprise Modernization, and a strong understanding of Agentic AI
* Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS solutions, ERP (particularly SAP), Salesforce, Dynamics CRM or ServiceNow), cybersecurity posture fundamentals, API ecosystems, along with legacy on-premise enterprise architectures.
* Strong background in Data Architecture, Integrations patterns, and a development background in data-related languages (SQL, Python, etc.)
* Strong technical background with a focus on system integrations, data operations, and automation capabilities.
* The ability to comfortably switch from explaining an architecture diagram to an environment where you have coded or assembled a demo of that architecture.
* MSc degree in Computer Science or an equivalent in an Information Technology-related field.
* Fluency in English is required; Swedish or Danish would be an advantage.


**Additional qualifications preferred:**
* Celonis Certifications and Experience with OCPM and Case Centric Data Pipelines.
* AWS/Azure/GCP Certifications.
* ESB / ETL Certifications (Mulesoft, Oracle, SAP, Talend, Informatica).
* TOGAF/Zachmann Certification.
* Experience in at least two domains among: Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Customer/Consumer Management (Service, Order Management, Sales), HR, Procurement.
* Experience in at least two industries among: Consumer Goods, Banking, Pharma, Aerospace, Telco, Transport.


**What Celonis can offer you:**
* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.


**About Us:**
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
   

  

 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
   

  

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
   

  

**Your Privacy:**
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
   

  

 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
   

  

**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
 We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
   

  

 The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
   

  

 Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Avalanche Studios Group is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our Data and Insights team!
   

  

 This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining scalable data pipelines and state-of-the-art data processing technologies. You will play a key role in our Data Engineering team, ensuring that our data infrastructure is reliable, performant, and successfully tied to delivering better data systems for our games and publishing activities. This role requires a deep understanding of data engineering methodologies/frameworks in a big-data environment ; coupled to a strong collaborative spirit.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop and implement processes to extract, clean, and transform data from various sources to ensure it is ready for modelling/consumption.
* Collaborate with analytics engineers, data scientists/analysts and product stakeholders to understand their data needs and provide them with reliable data solutions ; capturing a complete ecosystem view of in- and out-of-game user behaviors.
* Architect and implement robust, maintainable, and high-performance ETL/ELT pipelines and data systems ; ensuring accuracy, compliance, scalability, and long-term usability.
* Create and maintain comprehensive data documentation, including data dictionaries, schemas, and metadata. Ensure that data definitions are consistent and easily accessible to all stakeholders.
* Monitor data pipelines and systems to ensure high availability and performance alongside our analytics engineer ; implement automated data quality checks, validation processes and alerts ensuring the accuracy and reliability of data.
* Write efficient, maintainable, and scalable code using best practices. Conduct code and SQL reviews and provide feedback to ensure high standards of code quality within the team.
* Stay updated with the latest trends, technologies, frameworks and best practices in data engineering / analytics / AI and share knowledge with the team.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field ; with 8+ years experience in data engineering or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in big-data technologies and languages, such as Python, Spark, Scala, SQL, and Java.Experience with ETL/ELT processes and tools (e.g. Apache Airflow, Talend, DBT… DBT being a big plus).
* Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure… GCP being a big plus) ; and experience with “Infrastructure as Code” process (e.g. Terraform).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail ; coupled with strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
* Passion for gaming and a deep understanding of the gaming industry is a plus!


 Note: Research shows under-represented groups in the industry might not apply to a job if they don’t check off every requirement. At Avalanche, we’re more about your drive to learn and interest in tackling challenges than what’s on your resume! So don’t stress if you don’t tick every box— shoot us your application anyway! Diverse opinions and different experiences are what make our teams so great, not itemized lists of qualifications.
   

  

**The Stockholm location**
 Our Stockholm office is situated in Södermalm, the beating heart of the city’s game industry. It’s a physical representation of our games – the lush vegetation of Just Cause and theHunter: Call of the Wild meets corroded metal straight out of Mad Max. Our hybrid model requires you to be in the office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays to foster collaboration and creativity.
   

  

**Our values**
 At Avalanche Studios Group, we create worlds beyond limits. But that’s not exclusive to our games, so we’re committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. All Avalanchers have a shared responsibility to create an open work environment where everyone is treated equally and respectfully. Being part of our world is not contingent on your heritage, your gender, or sexual orientation. It’s all about your passion and creativity.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To apply for this position, please register below and provide your CV in English. We review applications continuously. All further studio-related information is provided under a non-disclosure agreement.
   

  

 At Avalanche Studios Group we're always on the lookout for talented individuals to join our passionate team, but please note that relocation assistance is not available for this role.

title: Channel Storage Presales Architect
description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As the Channel Storage Presales Architect, you will configure and design customer-focused solutions based on HPE storage portfolio products of block, object, file and data protection across hardware, software, services, and third-party technologies. You will develop proposals, align solutions to business and technical requirements, and provide technical expertise to support sales, customer engagement, and successful outcomes.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains: block, file, object storage and backup / data protection technologies.
* Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
* Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.
* Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Participates in deep-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.


**Your Profile**
***Education and Experience:***
* First-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.
* 5-8 years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling
* Knowledge-based as well as 1+ experienced-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs-of-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.
* Advanced ability to collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and Swedish as needed to perform job requirements.
* Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.
* Advanced resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
* Hands on experience with one or more products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
* Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
* Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Knowledge of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization, understanding of the company's go-to-market strategy.


**Accessibility**

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
   

  

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
